G0001G.d: Α, α, ἄλφα (which see), τό, indecl., alpha, the first letter of the Greek alphabet. As a numeral, ά = 1, α = 1000. As a prefix, it appears to have at least two and perhaps three distinct senses: 1. ἀ- (before a vowel, ἀν-) negative, as in ἄ-γνωστος, ἄ-δικος. 2. ἀ-, ἁ- copulative, indicating community and fellowship, as in ἁ-πλοῦς, ἀ-κολουθέω, ἀ-δελφός. 3. An intensive force (LS, s. α), as in ἀ-τενίζω is sometimes assumed (but see Boisacq, see word). (AS)
G0001G.ks: 헬라어 알파벳의 첫째 글자로 숫자 1을 나타낸다. 접두사로 쓰이면 부정이나 '함께'의 뜻을 더한다.

G0002.d: Ἀαρών (Heb. אַהֲרוֹן), indecl. (in FlJ, -ῶνος), Aaron (Exo.4:14, al.): Luk.1:5, Act.7:40, Heb.5:4, 7:11, 9:4.† (AS)

G0003.d: Ἀβαδδών (Heb. אֲבַדּוֹן, destruction; LXX, ἀπώλεια, only in Wisdom Lit., of the place of the ruined dead: Job.26:6, 28:22, 31:12, Psa.88:12, Pro.15:11*), indecl.; in NT, Abaddon, the angel of the Abyss: Rev.9:11.† (AS)

G0004.ks: 무게가 없다는 뜻에서, 비유로 짐이 되지 않는다는 뜻이다. 고린도후서 11:9에 쓰였다.

G0005.d: Ἀββά (T, -ᾶ), indecl. (Aram, אַבָּא, emphatic form of אַב = Heb. אָב, father), used in the phrase Ἀ. ὁ παήρ, Abba, Father (see Swete on Mk, I.with): Mrk.14:36, Rom.8:15, Gal.4:6.† (AS)
G0005.ks: 아람어로 '아버지'를 뜻하며 하나님을 친밀하게 부를 때 쓰인다. 막 14:36, 롬 8:15, 갈 4:6에 나온다.

G0006.d: Ἄβελ, (WH, Ἅ-), ὁ, indecl. (הֶבֶל), Abel (Gen.4:2-10): Heb.11:4, 12:24; αἵμα Ἄ., Mat.23:35, Luk.11:51.† (AS)

G0007G.d: Ἀβιά (Heb. אֲבִיָּה, אֲבִיָּהוּ), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀβίας, -α), Abia, Abijah. 1. Son of Rehoboam (3Ki.14:1): Mat.1:7. 2. A priest of the line of Eleazar (1Ch.24:3, 10): Luk.1:5. † (AS)

G0007H.d: Ἀβιά (Heb. אֲבִיָּה, אֲבִיָּהוּ), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀβίας, -α), Abia, Abijah. 1. Son of Rehoboam (3Ki.14:1): Mat.1:7. 2. A priest of the line of Eleazar (1Ch.24:3, 10): Luk.1:5. † (AS)
G0007H.ks: 엘르아살 계통의 제사장 가문, 사가랴의 반열 (눅 1:5)

G0009.d: Ἀβειληνή (T, Rec. Ἀβι-), -ῆς, ἡ, (sc. χώρα), Abilene, a district in the Anti-Lebanon: Luk.3:1.† (AS)

G0011.d: Ἀβραάμ (Heb. אַבְרָהָם), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἄβραμος, -ου; MM, VGT, see word), Abraham (Gen.17:5 al.): Mat.1:1, 2 al. (AS)

G0012.d: ἄ-βυσσος, -ον (Ion. βυσσός = βυθός), 1. in cl., boundless, bottomless (e.g. ἄ. πέλαγος, ἄ. πλοῦτος Æsch.). 2. [In LXX (for תְּהוֹם, Gen.1:2, al.; exc. Isa.44:27, Job.41:22 for צוּלָה, מְצוּלָה, Job.36:16 for רַחַב) and] NT, as subst. (MM, VGT, see word), ἡ ἄ. (sc. χώρα), the abyss; (a) of the sea (Gen.1:2); (b) of the underworld, as the abode of the dead: Rom.10:7 (a paraphrase of Deu.30:13 LXX); as the abode of demons, Luk.8:31, Rev.9:1, 2, 11, 11:7, 17:8, 20:1, 3 (Cremer, 2). † (AS)
G0012.ks: 바닥이 없는 깊은 곳을 뜻한다. 바다의 깊음이나 죽은 자들이 있는 곳, 악한 영들이 갇히는 곳을 가리킨다.

G0014.d: ἀγαθοεργέω, -ῶ, to do good, show kindness: 1 Ti 6:18 (Cremer, 8).† ἀγαθουργέω, -ῶ, contracted form (rare, see WH, App., 145) of ἀγαθοερ- (which see), to do good: Act.14:17.† (AS)
G0014.ks: 선을 행하고 친절을 베푼다는 뜻이다. 디모데전서 6:18에 쓰이며 사도행전 14:17에는 줄임꼴이 나온다.

G0015.d: ἀγαθὀ-ποιέω, -ῶ (= cl. ἀγαθὸν ποιεῖν, εὐεργετεῖν), [in LXX: Num.10:32, Jdg.17:13 A, Zep.1:12 (יטב hi.), Tob.12:13 B, 1Ma.11:33, 2Ma.1:2 * ;] to do good; (a) univ.: 1Pe.2:15, 20, 3:6, 17, 3Jo.11; (b) for another's benefit: Mrk.3:4 (T, ἀγαθὸν ποιῆσαι), Luk.6:9; (with) accusative of person(s), Luk.6:33, 35 (Cremer, 8). † (AS)
G0015.ks: 선한 일을 하다, 남의 유익을 위해 행하다라는 뜻이다. 벧전 2:15, 눅 6:9, 35 등에 쓰인다.

G0016.ks: 착한 일을 함, 선을 행함을 뜻하는 명사이다. 베드로전서 4:19에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0017.d: ἀγαθοποιός, -όν = cl. ἀγαθουργός, [in LXX, of a woman who deals pleasantly in order to corrupt, Sir.42:14 * ;] doing well, acting rightly (Plut.): 1Pe.2:14 (Cremer, 8; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0017.ks: 옳게 행하는 사람을 가리킨다. 베드로전서 2:14에서 선을 행하는 자를 상 주는 이들로 말한다.

G0018.d: ἀγαθός, -ή, -όν, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;] in general, good, in physical and in moral sense, used of persons, things, acts, conditions, etc., applied to that which is regarded as "perfect in its kind, so as to produce pleasure and satisfaction, . . . that which, in itself good, is also at once for the good and the advantage of him who comes in contact with it" (Cremer, 3): γῆ, Luk.8:8; δένδρον, Mat.7:18; καρδία, Luk.8:15; δόσις, Jas.1:17; μέρις, Luk.10:42; ἔργον (frequently in Pl.), Php.1:6; ἐλπίς, 2Th.2:16; θησαυρός, Mat.12:35; μνεία, 1Th.3:6 (cf. 2Ma.7:20); as subst., τὸ ἀ, that which is morally good, beneficial, acceptable to God, Rom.12:2; ἐργάζεσθαι τὸ ἀ, Rom.2:10, Eph.4:28; πράσσειν, Rom.9:11, 2Co.5:10; διώκειν, 1Th.5:15; μιμεῖσθαι, III Jo 11; κολλᾶσθαι τῷ ἀ, Rom.12:9; ερωτᾶν περὶ τοῦ ἀ., Mat.19:17; διάκονος εἰς τὸ ἀ., Rom.13:4; τὸ ἀ. σου, thy favour, benefit, Phm 14; pl., τὰ ἀ., of goods, possessions, Luk.12:18; of spiritual benefits, Rom.10:15, Heb.9:11, 10:1. ἀ is opposite to πονηρός, Mat.5:45, 20:5; κακός, Rom.7:19; φαῦλος, Rom.9:11, 2Co.5:10 (cf. MM, VGT, see word). SYN.: καλός, δίκαιος. κ. properly refers to goodliness as manifested in form: ἀ. to inner excellence (cf. the cl. καλὸς κἀγαθός and ἐν καρδία κ. καὶ ἀ., Luk.8:15). In Rom.5:7, where it is contrasted with δ., ἀ. implies a kindliness and attractiveness not necessarily possessed by the δίκαιος, who merely measures up to a high standard of rectitude (cf. ἀγαθωσύνη). (AS)
G0018.ks: 사람·사물·행위 등이 육체적·도덕적으로 좋음을 뜻하는 일반적인 단어이다. 칠십인역에서 주로 히브리어 '토브'에 해당한다.

G0019.d: ἀγαθωσύνη (on the termination, see: ἁγιότης, and cf . WH, App., 152; MM, VGT, see word), -ης, ἡ (ἀγαθός), [in LXX for טוֹבָה, טוֹב, טוּב, only in Heb. bks. ;] goodness (representing "the kindlier, as δικαιοσύνη, the sterner element in the ideal character," AE, Eph., 5:9; on its relation to χρηστότης, see Tr., Syn., §lxiii): Rom.15:14, Gal.5:22, 2Th.1:11.† (AS)
G0019.ks: 선한 성품을 가리키며, 성령의 열매 가운데 하나로 나온다(갈 5:22). 롬 15:14, 살후 1:11에도 쓰인다.

G0020.d: ἀγαλλίασις, -εως, ἡ (ἀγαλλιάω), [in LXX (most frequently in Pss. and often coupled with εὐφροσύνη, as Ps 44(45):15) chiefly for גִּיל ;] exultation, exuberant joy: Luk.1:44, Act.2:46, Heb.1:9, Ju 24; χαρὰ καὶ ἀ., Luk.1:14 (Cremer, 592).† (AS)
G0020.ks: 넘치도록 크게 기뻐함을 뜻한다. 눅 1:14, 44, 행 2:46, 히 1:9, 유 24에 쓰인다.

G0021.d: ἀγαλλιάω, -ῶ, Hellenistic form of cl. ἀγάλλω, to glorify, mid. -ομαι, to exult in; [in LXX (most frequently in Pss.) chiefly for גיל, רנן pi. ;] to exult, rejoice greatly: before ἐπί, with dative, Luk.1:47; with dative mod., 1Pe.1:8, Rev.19:7. Mid., with same sense: Mat.5:12, Luk.10:21, Act.2:26, 16:34, 1Pe.4:13; before ἵνα, Jhn.8:56; ἐν, Jhn.5:35 (1 aor. pass. perh. as mid.; but see Mozley, Psalter, 5), 1Pe.1:6 (Cremer, 590).† (AS)
G0021.ks: 크게 기뻐하며 즐거워한다는 뜻이다. 시편에 자주 나오며 눅 1:47, 마 5:12, 벧전 1:8 등에 쓰인다.

G0022.ks: 미혼인 사람을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 7:8, 32 등에서 남녀 모두에게 쓰인다.

G0023.d: ἀγανακτέω, -ῶ (ἄγαν, much, ἄχομαι, to grieve), [in LXX: Wis.5:22, 12:27, Da TH Bel 28, 4Ma.4:21 * ;] to be indignant: Mat.21:15, 26:8, Mrk.10:14, 14:4; before περί, Mat.20:24, Mrk.10:41; before ὅτι, Luk.13:14 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0023.ks: 화가 나서 분개하다라는 뜻이다. 마 21:15, 26:8, 막 10:14 등 제자들이나 사람들의 분개를 나타낸다.

G0024.d: ἀγανάκτησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀγανακτέω), [in LXX: Est.18:3 א 1 * ;] indignation: 2Co.7:11 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0024.ks: 분개하는 마음을 뜻한다. 고린도후서 7:11에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0025.d: ἀγαπάω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for אהב ;] to love, to feel and exhibit esteem and goodwill to a person, to prize and delight in a thing. 1. Of human affection, to men: τ. πλησίον, Mat.5:43; τ. ἐχθρούς, ib. 44; to Christ, Jhn.8:42; to God, Mat.22:37; with accusative of thing(s), Luk.11:43, Jhn.12:43, Eph.5:25, II Tim 4:8, 10, Heb.1:9, 1Pe.2:17, 3:10, 2Pe.2:15, 1Jn.2:15, Rev.12:11. 2. Of divine love; (a) God's love: to men, Rom.8:37; to Christ, Jhn.3:35; (b) Christ's love: to men, Mrk.10:21; to God, Jhn.14:31; with cogn. accusative, Jhn.17:26, Eph.2:4. SYN.: φιλέω. From its supposed etymology (Thayer, LS; but see also Boisacq) ἀ. is commonly understood properly to denote love based on esteem (diligo), as distinct from that expressed by φιλέω (amo), spontaneous natural affection, emotional and unreasoning. If this distinction holds, ἀ. is fitly used in NT of Christian love to God and man, the spiritual affection which follows the direction of the will, and which, therefore, unlike that feeling which is instinctive and unreasoned, can be commanded as a duty. (Cf. ἀγάπη, and v. Tr., Syn. §xii; Cremer, 9, 592; and esp. MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0025.ks: 사람에게 존중과 호의를 품고 나타내며, 사물을 귀히 여기고 즐거워한다는 뜻이다. 이웃, 원수, 그리스도, 하나님에 대한 사랑에 쓰인다.

G0026.d: ἀγάπη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX for אַהֲבָה, which is also rendered by ἀγάπησις and φιλία ;] love, goodwill, esteem. Outside of bibl. and eccl. books, there is no clear instance (with Deiss., LAE, 18:4, 70:2, cf. the same writer in Constr. Quar., ii, 4; and with MM, VGT, see word, cf. Dr. Moulton in Exp. Times, xxvi, 3, 139). In NT, like ἀγαπάω, -ῶ, 1. Of men's love: (a) to one another, Jhn.13:35; (b) to God, 1Jn.2:5. 2. Of divine love; (a) God's love: to men, Rom.5:8; to Christ, Jhn.17:26; (b) Christ's love to men: Rom.8:35. 3. In pl., love feasts: Ju 12 (DB, iii, 157). SYN.: φιλία. ἀ., signifying properly (see: ἀγαπάω) love which chooses its object, is taken over from LXX, where its connotation is more general, into NT, and there used exclusively to express that spiritual bond of love between God and man and between man and man, in Christ, which is characteristic of Christianity. It is thusdistinct from φιλία, friendship (Jas.4:4 only), στοργή, natural affection (in NT only in compounds, see: ἄστοργος) and ἔρως, sexual love, which is not used in NT, its place being taken by ἐπιθυμία. (Cf. ἀγαπάω; and see Abbott, Essays, 70f.; DB, vol. i., 555; Cremer, 13, 593; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0026.ks: 호의와 존중을 뜻하며, 성경과 교회 문헌에서 널리 쓰인다. 사람의 사랑과 하나님의 사랑 모두를 가리킨다.

G0027.d: ἀγαπητός, -ή, -όν (ἀγαπάω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתִיד, יָדִיד ;] beloved (see M, Pr., 221); (a) by God: of Christ, Mat.3:17; of men, Rom.1:7; (b) by Christians, of one another: 1Co.4:14; frequently as form of address, ib. 10:14; opposite to ἐχθρός, Rom.11:28 (see AR, Eph., 229; Cremer, 17; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0027.ks: 하나님께 사랑받는 자(그리스도와 성도)나 성도 서로를 부르는 말이다. 마 3:17, 롬 1:7, 고전 10:14 등에 쓰인다.

G0028.d: Ἅγαρ (Rec. Ἄ-), ἡ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀγάρα, -ης, Heb. הָגָר), Hagar (Gen.16): Gal.4:24,25.† (AS)

G0029.d: ἀγγαρεύω (from the Persian; cf. Vg. angiare, and the Heb. אִגֶרֶת; on the orthogr., see Bl., §6, 1; M, Pr., 46), to impress into public service, employ a courier; hence, to compel to perform a service (prob. common in the vernac.; cf. Deiss., BS, 86f., MM, Exp., iv; VGT, see word): Mat.5:41, 27:32, Mrk.15:21.† (AS)
G0029.ks: 페르시아에서 온 말로, 공무를 위해 강제로 부리다라는 뜻이다. 마 5:41, 27:32, 막 15:21에 쓰인다.

G0030.d: ἀγγεῖον, -ου, τό (ἄγγος), [in LXX chiefly for כְּלִי ;] a vessel (see MM, VGT, see word): Mat.25:4.† (AS)
G0030.ks: 물건을 담는 그릇을 뜻한다. 마태복음 25:4에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0031.d: ἀγγελία, -ας, ἡ (ἄγγελος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁמוּעָה ;] a message: 1Jo.1:5, 3:11 (Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0031.ks: 전해진 소식이나 말씀을 뜻한다. 요한일서 1:5, 3:11에 쓰인다.

G0032G.d: ἄγγελος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for מַלְאָךְ ;] 1. a messenger, one sent: Mat.11:10, Jas.22:25. 2. As in LXX, in the special sense of angel, a spiritual, heavenly being, attendant upon God and employed as his messenger to men, to make known his purposes, as Luk.1:11, or to execute them, as Mat.4:6. The ἄ. in Rev.1:20-2:1, al., is variously understood as (1) a messenger or delegate, (2) a bishop or ruler, (3) a guardian angel, (4) the prevailing spirit of each church, i.e. the Church itself. (Cf. Swete, Ap)., in l.; DB, iv, 991; Thayer, see word; Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0032G.ks: 하나님을 모시고 그 뜻을 사람에게 전하거나 실행하는 영적 존재이다. 또한 보냄을 받은 사자를 가리키기도 한다.

G0032H.d: ἄγγελος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for מַלְאָךְ ;] 1. a messenger, one sent: Mat.11:10, Jas.22:25. 2. As in LXX, in the special sense of angel, a spiritual, heavenly being, attendant upon God and employed as his messenger to men, to make known his purposes, as Luk.1:11, or to execute them, as Mat.4:6. The ἄ. in Rev.1:20-2:1, al., is variously understood as (1) a messenger or delegate, (2) a bishop or ruler, (3) a guardian angel, (4) the prevailing spirit of each church, i.e. the Church itself. (Cf. Swete, Ap)., in l.; DB, iv, 991; Thayer, see word; Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0032H.ks: 보냄을 받은 사람, 곧 전령을 뜻한다. 마 11:10 등에서 사람 사자를 가리킨다.

G0034.d: ἀγέλη, -ης, ἡ (ἄγω), [in LXX chiefly for עֵ֫דֶר ;] a herd: Mat.8:30-32, Mrk.5:11, 13, Luk.8:32,33.† (AS)
G0034.ks: 짐승의 무리를 뜻한다. 마 8:30-32, 막 5:11, 눅 8:32에서 돼지 떼를 가리킨다.

G0035.d: ἀγενεαλόγητος, -ον (γενεαλογέω), without genealogy, i.e. without recorded pedigree (cf. Neh.7:64): Heb.7:3 (Cremer, 152; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0035.ks: 기록된 족보가 없음을 뜻한다. 히브리서 7:3에서 멜기세덱에 대해 쓰였다.

G0036.d: ἀγενής, -ές (γένος), 1. unborn (Plat.); 2. of no family, ignoble, base (opposite to ἀγαθός, Soph., Fr., 105): opposite to εὐγενής, 1Co.1:28 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0036.ks: 가문이 없는, 낮고 비천한 사람을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 1:28에서 '귀한 자'와 대비되어 쓰였다.

G0037.d: ἁγιάζω, Hellenistic form of ἁγίζω (ἅγιος), to make holy, consecrate, sanctify; [in LXX chiefly for קדשׁ pi., hi. ;] 1. to dedicate, separate, set apart for God; of things: Mat.23:17,19, 2Ti.2:21; of persons: Christ, Jhn.10:36, 17:19. 2. to purify, make conformable in character to such dedication: forensically, to free from guilt, 1Co.6:11, Eph.5:26, Heb.2:11, 10:10, 14, 29, 13:12; internally, by actual sanctification of life, Jhn.17:17, 19, Act.20:32, 26:18, Rom.15:16, 1Co.1:2, 7:14, 1Th.5:23, Rev.22:11; of a nonbeliever influenced by marriage with a Christian, 1Co.7:14. 3. In the intermediate sense of ceremonial or levitical purification: (a) of things, 2Ti.2:21; (b) of persons, Heb.9:13. 4. to treat as holy: Mat.6:9, Luk.11:2, 1Pe.3:16 (Cremer, 53, 602; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0037.ks: 하나님께 드려 구별하다, 또는 죄에서 깨끗이 하여 그 구별에 맞는 성품이 되게 한다는 뜻이다. 사물과 사람 모두에 쓰인다.

G0038.d: ἁγιασμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἁγιάζω), [in LXX: Eze.45:4 (מִקְדָּשׁ), Sir.7:31, etc. ;] as an active verbal noun in -μός, it signifies properly the process τὸ ἁγιάζειν, rather than the resultant state, ἁγιωσύνη, hence, 1. consecration; 2. sanctification: so strictly in Rom.6:19,22 (but see Meyer), 1Co.1:30, 1Th.4:3,7, 2Th.2:13, Heb.12:14, 1Pe.1:2. Elsewhere it perhaps (Ellic.; but see Milligan, Th., 48) inclines to the resultant state: 1Th.4:4, 1Ti.2:15 (Cremer, 55, 602). † (AS)
G0038.ks: 거룩하게 되는 과정을 가리키는 말로, 구별하여 드림과 성화를 뜻한다. 롬 6:19, 22, 살전 4:3, 히 12:14 등에 쓰인다.

G0039G.d: ἅγιος, -α, ον (τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;] primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration. 1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence (a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1; (b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5. 2. Applied to persons as separated to God's service: (a) of Christ, Mrk.1:24, Jhn.6:69, Act.4:30; (b) of Christians, Act.9:13, Rom.1:7, Heb.6:10, Rev.5:8. 3. In the moral sense of sharing God's purity: Mrk.6:20, Jhn.17:11, Act.3:14, Rev.3:7. 4. Of pure, clean sacrifices and offerings: 1Co.7:14, Eph.1:4. SYN.: ἁγνός, pure, both in ceremonial and spiritual sense; ἱερός (sacer), sacred, that which is inviolable because of its (external) relation to God; ὅσιος (sanctus as opposite to nefas), that which is based on everlasting ordinances of right. (Cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxviii; DB, ii, 399 f.; Cremer, 34, 594-601; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0039G.ks: 하나님께 구별된 것을 가리키는 '거룩한'의 중성형으로, 성소를 뜻하기도 한다. 하나님의 순결과 위엄을 나타내는 말이다.

G0039H.d: ἅγιος, -α, ον (τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;] primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration. 1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence (a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1; (b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5. 2. Applied to persons as separated to God's service: (a) of Christ, Mrk.1:24, Jhn.6:69, Act.4:30; (b) of Christians, Act.9:13, Rom.1:7, Heb.6:10, Rev.5:8. 3. In the moral sense of sharing God's purity: Mrk.6:20, Jhn.17:11, Act.3:14, Rev.3:7. 4. Of pure, clean sacrifices and offerings: 1Co.7:14, Eph.1:4. SYN.: ἁγνός, pure, both in ceremonial and spiritual sense; ἱερός (sacer), sacred, that which is inviolable because of its (external) relation to God; ὅσιος (sanctus as opposite to nefas), that which is based on everlasting ordinances of right. (Cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxviii; DB, ii, 399 f.; Cremer, 34, 594-601; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0039H.ks: '거룩한'의 중성형으로, 성막의 가장 거룩한 곳인 지성소를 가리키는 쓰임이다. 하나님께 구별된 장소를 뜻한다.

G0040G.d: ἅγιος, -α, ον (τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;] primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration. 1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence (a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1; (b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5. 2. Applied to persons as separated to God's service: (a) of Christ, Mrk.1:24, Jhn.6:69, Act.4:30; (b) of Christians, Act.9:13, Rom.1:7, Heb.6:10, Rev.5:8. 3. (Cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxviii; DB, ii, 399 f.; Cremer, 34, 594-601; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0040G.ks: 하나님께 구별되어 드려진, 공경받기에 합당한 것을 뜻한다. 하나님 자신과 성령, 성도, 성물에 쓰인다.

G0040H.d: ἅγιος, -α, ον (τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;] primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration. 1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence (a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1; (b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5. 2. Applied to persons as separated to God's service: (a) of Christ, Mrk.1:24, Jhn.6:69, Act.4:30; (b) of Christians, Act.9:13, Rom.1:7, Heb.6:10, Rev.5:8. 3. In the moral sense of sharing God's purity: Mrk.6:20, Jhn.17:11, Act.3:14, Rev.3:7. 4. Of pure, clean sacrifices and offerings: 1Co.7:14, Eph.1:4. SYN.: ἁγνός, pure, both in ceremonial and spiritual sense; ἱερός (sacer), sacred, that which is inviolable because of its (external) relation to God; ὅσιος (sanctus as opposite to nefas), that which is based on everlasting ordinances of right. (Cf. Tr., Syn., §lxxxviii; DB, ii, 399 f.; Cremer, 34, 594-601; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0040H.ks: 하나님께 구별된 사람, 곧 성도를 가리키는 쓰임이다. '거룩한'이 명사처럼 쓰인 경우이다.

G0041.d: ἁγιότης, -ητος, ἡ (ἅγιος), [in LXX: 2Ma.15:2 * ;] sanctity, holiness, regarded, properly, as an abstract quality (see next word, and cf. Lft. Notes, 49; MM, VGT, see word): 2Co.1:12, Heb.12:10.† (AS)
G0041.ks: 추상적인 성질로서의 거룩함을 뜻한다. 고린도후서 1:12, 히브리서 12:10에 쓰인다.

G0042.d: ἁγιωσύνη (cf. ἀγαθωσύνη), -ης, ἡ (ἅγιος), [in LXX: Psa.29 (30):4 96(97):12 (קֹדֶשׁ), 95(96):6 (עֹז), 144(145):5 (הוֹד), 2Ma.3:12 * ;] holiness, the state in man resulting from ἁγιασμός, which see: Rom.1:4, 2Co.7:1, 1Th.3:13 (Cremer, 52; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0042.ks: 성화의 결과로 사람에게 나타나는 거룩한 상태를 뜻한다. 롬 1:4, 고후 7:1, 살전 3:13에 쓰인다.

G0043.d: ἀγκάλη,-ης, ἡ (ἄγκος, a bend), [in LXX for אַצִּיל, חֵיק ;] the bent arm: Luk.2:28 (cf. ἐναγκαλίζομαι).† (AS)
G0043.ks: 굽힌 팔, 품을 뜻한다. 누가복음 2:28에서 시므온이 아기를 안은 장면에 쓰였다.

G0044.d: ἄγκιστρον, -ου, τό (ἄγκος, a bend), [in LXX חַכָּה, etc. ;] a fish-hook: Mat.17:27.† (AS)
G0044.ks: 고기를 잡는 낚시 바늘을 뜻한다. 마태복음 17:27에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0045.d: ἄγκυρα, -ας, ἡ (ἄγκος, a bend), [in Sm.: Jer.52:18 * ;] an anchor: Act.27:29, 30 40 ; figuratively (MM, VGT, see word), Heb.6:19.† (AS)
G0045.ks: 배를 고정하는 닻을 뜻한다. 행 27:29, 30, 40에 쓰이고 히브리서 6:19에서는 비유로 쓰인다.

G0046.d: ἄγναφος, -ον (= ἄγναπτος, γνάπτω, late form of κνάπτω, to card wool), uncarded, undressed, i.e. new (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.92:6, Mrk.2:21.† (AS)
G0046.ks: 표백하거나 손질하지 않은 새 천을 뜻한다. 마 9:16, 막 2:21에 쓰인다.

G0047.d: ἁγνεία (WH, ἁγνία), [in LXX for טָהֳרָה, נָזִיר, נֶזֶר, etc. ;] purity: 1Ti.4:12, 5:2 (Cremer, 58. For exx. of ceremonial use in π., see MM, Exp., iv).† (AS)

G0048.d: ἁγνίζω (> ἁγνός), [in LXX always ceremonially, chiefly for קָדַשׁ ;] to purify, cleanse from defilement; (a) ceremonially: Jhn.11:55, Act.21:24, 26 24:18; (b) morally: Jas.4:8, 1Pe.1:22, 1Jn.3:3. † SYN.: καθαρίζω, which see (and see: ἁγνός). (AS)
G0048.ks: 더러움에서 깨끗하게 하다라는 뜻이다. 의식적으로 몸을 정결하게 하거나 도덕적으로 마음을 깨끗하게 함을 가리킨다.

G0049.d: ἁγνισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (> ἁγνίζω), [in LXX: Num.6:5 (נֵזֶר) 8:7 19:17 (חַטָּאָה), etc. ;] purification: in ceremonial sense, Act.21:26 (LXX).† (AS)
G0049.ks: 정결하게 하는 의식을 뜻한다. 사도행전 21:26에 쓰였다.

G0050.d: ἀγνοέω, -ῶ (> ἁγνίζω), [in LXX for שָׁגָה, שָׁגַג, אָשַׁם, etc. ;] 1. to be ignorant, not to know: absol., Ι Ti 1:13, Heb.5:2; with accusative, Act.13:27 17:23, Rom.10:3, 2Co.2:11; ἐν οἷς, 2Pe.2:12; before ὅτι, Rom.2:4 6:3 7:1, 1Co.14:38; οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, a Pauline phrase: with accusative, Rom.11:25; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.1:8; περί, 1Co.12:1, 1Th.4:13. ὅτι, Rom.1:13, 1Co.10:1 (for similar usage in π., V. MM, VGT, see word). Pass.: 1Co.14:38, 2Co.6:9, Gal.1:22. 2. not to understand: with accusative, Mrk.9:32, Luk.9:45. † (AS)
G0050.ks: 모르다, 무지하다라는 뜻이다. 바울이 '형제들아 너희가 알지 못하기를 원하지 아니하노니'라고 할 때 쓰인다.

G0051.d: ἀγνόημα, -τός, τό (ἀγνοέω), [in LXX: Gen.43:12 (מִשְׁגֶּה), Tob.3:3, Jdth.5:20, Sir.23:2 51:19, 1Ma.13:39 * ;] a sin of ignorance (so in π.; see MM, VGT, see word): Heb.9:7.† (AS)
G0051.ks: 알지 못하고 지은 죄를 뜻한다. 히브리서 9:7에서 백성의 허물에 쓰였다.

G0052.d: ἄγνοια, -ας, ἡ (ἀγνοέω), [in LXX chiefly for אָשָׁם, שְׁגָגָה ;] ignorance : Act.3:17 17:30, Eph.4:18 (with sense of wilful blindness; cf. MM, VGT, see word), 1Pe.1:14.† (AS)
G0052.ks: 알지 못함을 뜻한다. 행 3:17, 17:30, 엡 4:18, 벧전 1:14에 쓰인다.

G0053.d: ἁγνός, -ή, -όν (ἅγος, see: ἅγιος), [in LXX chiefly for טָהוֹר (Pss, and Pr. only), also 2Ma.13:8, 4Ma.18:7, al. ;] 1. free from ceremonial defilement, in a condition prepared for worship (for exx. of pagan usage, V. MM, VGT, see word). 2. holy, sacred, venerable (II Mac, l.with). 3. As in OT (cl.), pure, chaste, undefiled, guiltless; (a) of persons: 2Co.7:11 11:12, 1Ti.5:22, Tit.2:5, 1Jn.3:3; (b) of things: Php.4:8, Jas.3:17, 1Pe.3:2. † SYN.: εἰλικρινής (which see), pure, primarily as winnowed, purged, first found in ethical sense in NT (sincere). On the equivalence of ἁ. and καθαρός (which see), see DCG, ii, 459a though Westc. (Epp. Jo., 101) notes a distinction between them. (AS)
G0053.ks: 의식적인 부정에서 벗어난, 또는 도덕적으로 순결하고 흠 없는 상태를 뜻한다. 사람과 행위에 쓰인다.

G0056.d: ἀγνωσία, -ας, ἡ (γινώσκω), [in LXX: Job.35:16 (בִּבְלִי־דַּעַת), Wis.13:1, 3Ma.5:27 * ;] ignorance (opposite to γνῶσις): 1Co.15:34, 1Pe.2:15 (see Hort in l.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0056.ks: 앎이 없는 상태를 뜻하며 '앎'의 반대말이다. 고린도전서 15:34, 베드로전서 2:15에 쓰인다.

G0057.d: ἄγνωστος, -ον (γινώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.11:18 18:3, 2Ma.1:19 2:7 (Cremer, 157) * ;] unknown: Act.17:23 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0057.ks: 모르는, 알려지지 않은 것을 뜻한다. 사도행전 17:23의 '알지 못하는 신'에 쓰였다.

G0058.d: ἀγορά, -ας, ἡ (ἀγείρω, to bring together) [in LXX for עִזָּבוֹן, שׁוּק ;] 1. an assembly (Hom., Xen., al.). 2. a place of assembly, a public place or forum, a market-place (Hom., Thuc, al.; LXX): Mat.11:16 20:2 23:7, Mrk.6:56 (cf . MM, VGT, see word, ἀγυιά) 7:4 (Bl., §46, 7) 12:38, Luk.7:32 (Bl., l.with) 11:43 20:46, Act.16:19 17:7 (Cremer, 59; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0058.ks: 사람들이 모이는 광장이나 시장을 뜻한다. 마 11:16, 20:2, 23:7, 막 7:4, 행 16:19 등에 쓰인다.

G0059.d: ἀγοράζω (ἀγορά), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבר, קנה ;] 1. to frequent the ἀγορά (Hdt., al.). 2. to buy in the market, purchase (Xen., al.; LXX; in π. very common in deeds of sale, see MM, VGT, see word): absol., Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:44, 46, al.; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), Rev.3:18 (LXX, Polyb.); ἐκ, Mat.27:7; with genitive pret., Mrk.6:37, al.; metaphorically, 1Co.6:20 7:23, 2Pe.2:1, Rev.5:9 14:3, 4. (AS)
G0059.ks: 시장에서 물건을 사다라는 뜻이다. 마 13:44, 46, 막 11:15, 계 3:18 등에 쓰인다.

G0060.d: ἀγοραῖος, -ον (ἀγορά), 1. frequenting the ἀγορά , a lounger in the ἀγορά (Xen., al.): Act.17:5. 2. In late writers (Strab., al.), proper to the ἀγορά : ἀγοραῖοι (sc. ἥμεραι) ἀγονται (cf. Lat. conventus agere), court-days are kept, Act.19:38 (for exx. of both usages, see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0060.ks: 장터에 자주 드나드는 사람, 또는 재판일을 뜻한다. 사도행전 17:5, 19:38에 쓰인다.

G0061.d: ἄγρα, -ας, ἡ (ἄγω), 1. the chase, a hunting or catching: Luk.5:4. 2. that which is taken, a catch: of fish, Luk.5:9. † (AS)
G0061.ks: 잡는 일이나 잡은 것을 뜻한다. 눅 5:4에서 고기 잡음, 눅 5:9에서 잡은 고기를 가리킨다.

G0062.d: ἀγραυλέω, -ῶ (ἀγραυλος, dwelling in the field; ἀγρός, αὐλή), to live in the fields: Luk.2:8.† (AS)

G0063.ks: 들에서 살며 밤을 지새운다는 뜻이다. 누가복음 2:8에서 목자들이 들에서 양을 지키는 모습에 쓰였다.

G0064.d: ἀγρεύω (ἄγρα), [in LXX: Job.10:16, Pro.5:22 6:25,26, Hos.5:2 (לקח ni., שׁחט, etc.)* ;] to catch or take by hunting or fishing; metaphorically, Mrk.12:13.† (AS)
G0064.ks: 사냥이나 고기잡이로 잡다라는 뜻이다. 막 12:13에서는 말로 올무에 걸리게 한다는 비유로 쓰인다.

G0065.d: ἀγρι-έλαιος, -ον 1. of the wild olive (Anth.). 2. As subst., the wild olive: Rom.11:17, 24 (CGT, in 1.; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0065.ks: 야생 감람나무를 뜻한다. 로마서 11:17, 24에서 이방인 성도를 비유하는 데 쓰인다.

G0066.d: ἄγριος, -α, -ον (ἀγρός), [in LXX for שָׂדֶה, etc. ;] 1. living in fields, wild: μέλι. Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6. 2. savage, fierce: Ju 13. (Cf. usage in π. of a malignant wound; MM, VGT, see word) † (AS)
G0066.ks: 들에 사는 야생의, 또는 사납고 거친 것을 뜻한다. 마 3:8의 '석청', 유다서 13에 쓰인다.

G0067.d: Ἀγρίππας, -α (Bl., §7, 2), ὁ Agrippa (II): Act.25:13, 22, 23, 24, 26 26:1, 2, 19, 27, 28, 32. (For Agrippa I, see: Ἡρῴδης, 3.) † (AS)

G0068G.d: ἀγρός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for שָׂדֶה ]; 1. a field: Mat.6:28, al. 2. the country: Mrk.15:21, al.; pl., country places, farms: Mrk.5:14 6:36 56, Luk.8:34 9:12. 3. = χωρίον a piece of ground: Mrk.10:29, Act.4:27, al. (On the occurrence of this word as compared with χώρα, χωρίον see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0068G.ks: 경작지나 들판, 시골을 뜻한다. 마 6:28, 막 5:14, 눅 8:34 등에 쓰인다.

G0068H.d: ἀγρός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for שָׂדֶה ]; 1. a field: Mat.6:28, al. 2. the country: Mrk.15:21, al.; pl., country places, farms: Mrk.5:14 6:36 56, Luk.8:34 9:12. 3. = χωρίον a piece of ground: Mrk.10:29, Act.4:27, al. (On the occurrence of this word as compared with χώρα, χωρίον see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0068H.ks: '밭'을 뜻하는 낱말로, 가룟 유다의 배신 값으로 산 '피밭'을 가리키는 쓰임이다.

G0069.d: ἀγρυπνέω, -ῶ (ἄγρυπνος, seeking sleep ; ἀγρεύω, ὕπνος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁקד ;] to be sleepless, wakeful (Theogn., Xen., al.); metaphorically (LXX) = cl. ἐγρήγορα, to be watchful, vigilant: Mrk.13:33, Luk.21:36, Eph.6:18, Heb.13:17.† SYN.: γρηγορέω, which see; νήφω, associated with γ. in 1Pe.5:8, expressing a wariness which results from self-control, a condition of moral, not merely mental alertness (see M, Th., I, 5:6). (AS)
G0069.ks: 잠들지 않고 깨어 경계하다라는 뜻이다. 막 13:33, 눅 21:36, 엡 6:18, 히 13:17에 쓰인다.

G0070.d: ἀγρυπνία, -ας, ἡ (see supr.), [in LXX: Si .9, 2Ma.2:26 * ;] sleeplessness, watching: 2Co.6:5 11:27. (Plat., Hdt.; for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word) † (AS)
G0070.ks: 잠들지 못하고 깨어 있음을 뜻한다. 고린도후서 6:5, 11:27에 쓰인다.

G0071.d: ἄγω, [in LXX for בּוא hi., לקח, נהג, etc. ;] 1. to lead, bring, carry: with ace, before ἐπί, εἰς, ἕως, πρός and simple dative; metaphorically, to lead, guide, impel: Jhn.10:16 Rom.2:4, Heb.2:10, 2Ti.3:6, al. 2. to spend or keep a day: Luk.24:21, Act.19:38 3. Intrans., to go: subjunc., ἄγωμεν, Mat.2:46, al. (Cramer, 61; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0071.ks: 이끌다, 데려가다, 인도하다라는 뜻이다. 그 밖에 날을 보내다, 가다의 뜻으로도 쓰인다.

G0072.d: ἀγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἄγω), [in LXX: Est.2:20 10:3, 2Ma.4:16 6:8 11:24, 3Ma.4:10 * ;] 1. a carrying away. 2. a leading, guiding; metaphorically, training; hence, from the expression ἀ. τοῦ βίου, absol., conduct, way of life: 2Ti.3:10 (Cremer, 61; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0072.ks: 이끎, 훈련에서 나아가 삶의 행실을 뜻한다. 디모데후서 3:10에서 바울의 행실을 가리킨다.

G0073.d: ἀγών, -ῶνος, ὁ (ἄγω), [in LXX: Isa.7:13 (לאה), Est.4:17, Wis.4:2 10:12, II Mac.6, 4Mac .5 * ;] 1. a gathering, esp. for games. 2. a place of assembly. 3. a contest, struggle, trial; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word), (a) of the Christian life as a contest and struggle: Php.1:30, 1Th.2:2, 1Ti.6:12, 2Ti.4:7 Heb.12:1; (b) solicitude, anxiety: Col.2:1. † (AS)
G0073.ks: 모임과 경기장에서 나아가 경기, 싸움, 시련을 뜻한다. 그리스도인의 삶의 싸움이나 근심을 가리킨다.

G0074.d: ἀγωνία, -ας, ἡ (ἀγών), [in LXX: 2Ma.3:14,16 15:19 * ;] 1. a contest, wrestling (Eur., Xen.). 2. Of the mind, great fear, agony, anguish (Dem., Arist.): Luk.22:44 (cf . Field, Notes, 77 f. ; Abbott, Essays, 101 f. ; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0074.ks: 경기나 씨름에서 나아가 마음의 큰 두려움과 고뇌를 뜻한다. 누가복음 22:44에 쓰였다.

G0075.d: ἀγωνίζομαι (ἀγών), [in LXX: Da TH 6:14 (שׂוּם בָּל), Sir.4:28, I, II, 4Mac .5 * ;] 1. to contend for a prize: 1Co.9:25, 2. to fight, struggle, strive: Jhn.18:36; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). Col.1:29 4:12, 1Ti.4:10 6:12, 2Ti.4:7; with inf. (Field, Notes, 66), Luk.13:24 (Cremer, 609) † (AS)
G0075.ks: 상을 얻으려 겨루다, 싸우다, 힘써 애쓰다라는 뜻이다. 고전 9:25, 골 1:29, 딤전 6:12, 딤후 4:7 등에 쓰인다.

G0076.d: Ἀδάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָדָם), Adam: Luk.3:38, Rom.5:14, 1Co.15:22,45, 1Ti.2:13,14 Ju 14. Christ ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀ., 1Co.15:45.† (AS)

G0077.ks: 비용이 들지 않는, 무료임을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 9:18에서 값없이 복음을 전함을 말한다.

G0079.d: ἀδελφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀδελφός), [in LXX for אָהוֹת ;] a sister: Mat.19:29, al.; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word), of a member of the Christian community: Rom.16:1, 1Co.7:15 Jas.21:15, al. (AS)
G0079.ks: 누이나 자매를 뜻하며, 비유로 그리스도인 공동체의 여성 성도를 가리키기도 한다. 롬 16:1, 고전 7:15에 쓰인다.

G0080.d: ἀδελφός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀ- copul., δελφύς, womb), in cl., a brother, born of the same parent or parents. [In LXX (Hort, Ja., 102f.), for אָח ;] 1. lit. of a brother (Gen.4:2, al.). 2. Of a neighbour (Lev.19:17). 3. Of a member of the same nation (Exo.2:14, Deu.15:3). In NT in each of these senses (1. Mat.1:2, al.; 2. Mat.7:3; 3. Rom.9:3) and also, 4. of a fellow-Christian: 1Co.1:1, Act.9:30. This usage finds illustration in π., where ἀ. is used of members of a pagan religious community (M, Th., I, 1:4; MM, VGT, see word). The ἀδελφοὶ τ. Κυρίου (Mat.12:46-49 13:55 28:10, Mrk.3:31-34, Luk.8:19-21, Jhn.2:12 7:3, 5 10 20:17, Act.1:14, 1Co.9:5) may have been sons of Joseph and Mary (Mayor, Ja., Intr. viff.; DB, i, 320ff.) or of Joseph by a former marriage (Lft., Gal., 252ff.; DCG, i, 232ff.), but the view of Jerome, which makes ἀ. equivalent to ἀνεψιός, is inconsistent with Greek usage. (Cremer, 66.) (AS)
G0080.ks: 같은 부모에게서 난 형제, 이웃, 같은 민족, 그리고 신약에서는 믿는 형제를 뜻한다.

G0081.d: ἀδελφότης, -ητος, ἡ (ἀδελφός), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:10,17, 4Mac .5 * ;] 1. abstract, brotherhood, brotherly affection (LXX). 2. Concrete, the brotherhood, the Christian community: 1Pe.2:17 5:9 (MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0081.ks: 형제의 사랑과 그리스도인 공동체를 뜻한다. 베드로전서 2:17, 5:9에 쓰인다.

G0082.d: ἄ-δηλος, -ον (δῆλος), [in LXX: Ps 50 (51):6 (בַּטֻחוֹת) ;] 1. unseen, unobserved, not manifest (Ps, l.with): Luk.11:44. 2. uncertain, indistinct: 1Co.14:8. † (AS)
G0082.ks: 보이지 않는, 확실치 않은 것을 뜻한다. 눅 11:44의 평토장한 무덤, 고전 14:8의 분명치 않은 소리에 쓰인다.

G0083.ks: 확실하지 않음을 뜻한다. 디모데전서 6:17에서 재물의 불확실함을 말한다.

G0084.ks: 목적이 불분명하게라는 뜻의 부사이다. 고린도전서 9:26에서 방향 없이 달림을 말한다.

G0085.d: ἀδημονέω, -ῶ (on the derivation, see MM, VGT, see word), [in Aq.: Job.18:20; Sm.: Psa.60 (61):3 115:2 (116:11), Ecc.7:17(16), Eze.3:15 * ;] to be troubled, distressed (MM, l.with): Mat.26:37, Mrk.14:33, Php.2:26.† (AS)
G0085.ks: 괴로워하고 번민하다라는 뜻이다. 마 26:37, 막 14:33, 빌 2:26에 쓰인다.

G0086.d: ᾅδης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX ehiefly for שְׁאוֹל, also for דּוּמָה, מָוֶת, etc. ;] 1. in Hom., Hades (Pluto), the god of the underworld. 2. the abode of Hades, the underivorld; in NT, the abode of departed spirits, Hades: ἐν τ. ᾅ., Luk.16:23; εἰς ᾅ., Act.2:27,31; πύλαι ᾅδου, Mat.16:18; κλεῖς τοῦ ᾅ., Rev.1:18; metaphorically, ἕως ᾅ., Mat.11:23, Luk.10:15; personified, Rev.6:8 20:13,14 (Cremer, 67, 610; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0086.ks: 죽은 자들의 영이 머무는 곳, 곧 음부를 뜻한다. 눅 16:23, 행 2:27, 마 16:18, 계 1:18 등에 쓰인다.

G0087.d: ἀ-διά-κριτος, -ον (διακρίνω), [in LXX: Pro.25:1 * ;] 1. not to be parted, mixed, undistinguishable (cf. Pr, l.with, and see Lft., Ignat. Eph., §3). 2. without uncertainty (Hort, in l., but see MM, VGT, see word): Jas.3:17. † (AS)
G0087.ks: 나뉘지 않은, 또는 의심 없이 공평함을 뜻한다. 야고보서 3:17에서 위로부터 난 지혜의 특징으로 쓰인다.

G0088.d: ἀδιάλειπτος, -ον (διαλείπω), unremitting, incessant: Rom.9:2, 2Ti.1:3. (For exx., see MM, VGT, see word) † (AS)
G0088.ks: 쉬지 않는, 그치지 않는 것을 뜻한다. 로마서 9:2, 디모데후서 1:3에 쓰인다.

G0089.d: ἀδιαλείπτως (see supr.), adv., [in LXX: 1Ma.12:11, II Mac .4, 3Ma.6:33 * ;] unremittingly, incessantly: Rom.1:9, 1Th.1:3 2:13 5:17.† (AS)
G0089.ks: 그치지 않고 계속이라는 뜻의 부사이다. 롬 1:9, 살전 1:3, 2:13, 5:17에 쓰인다.

G0091.d: ἀδικέω, -ῶ (ἄδικος), [in LXX for עשׁק, עוה, etc. ;] 1. intrans., to be ἄδικος, do wrong, act wickedly or criminally: Act.25:11, 1Co.6:8, 2Co.7:12, Col.3:25, Rev.22:11; to do hurt, Rev.9:19. 2. Trans. (a) to do some wrong: ὃ ἠδίκησεν, Col.3:25; to wrong some one, Mat.20:13, Act.7:26, 27 25:10, 2Co.7:2, Gal.4:12, Phm 18, 2Pe.2:13; pass., Act.7:24, 2Co.7:12; mid., 1Co.6:7 (suffer . . . to be wronged; WM, §38, 3; but see Bl., §54, 5; and cf. ἀποστερέω); (b) to injure, hurt: Luk.10:19 Rev.2:11 6:6 7:2, 3 9:4,10 11:5. † (AS)
G0091.ks: 잘못을 저지르다, 남에게 해를 끼치다라는 뜻이다. 사람을 부당하게 대함을 가리킨다.

G0092.d: ἀδίκημα, -τος, τό (ἀδικέω), [in LXX for עָוֹן, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;] a wrong, injury, misdeed (MM, VGT, see word): Act.18:14 24:20, Rev.18:5.† (AS)
G0092.ks: 잘못, 해악, 나쁜 행위를 뜻한다. 행 18:14, 24:20, 계 18:5에 쓰인다.

G0093.d: ἀδικία, -ας, ἡ (ἄδικος), [in LXX for עָוֹן, פֶּשַׁע, עָוֶל, etc. ;] 1. injustice: Luk.18:6, Rom.9:14. 2. unrighteousness, iniquity: Jhn.7:18, Act.8:23, Rom.1:18, 29 2:8 6:13, 2Ti.2:19, 1Jn.1:9 5:17; opposite to ἀλήθεια, 1Co.13:6, 2Th.2:12; to δικαιοσύνη ], Rom.3:5; ἀπάτη τῆς ἀ., 2Th.2:10; μισθὸς ἀδικίας, Act.1:18, 2Pe.2:13,15; ἐγράται τῆς ἀ., Luk.13:27; μαμωνᾶς τῆς ἀ., Luk.16:9; κόσμος τῆς ἀ., Jas.3:6; οἰκονόμος τῆς ἀ., Luk.16:8. 3. = ἀδίκημα, an unrighteous act: ironically, a favour, 2Co.12:13; pl., Heb.8:12 (Cremer, 261; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0093.ks: 부당함과 옳지 않음을 뜻하며, 진리와 의의 반대이다. 롬 1:18, 요일 1:9, 5:17 등에 쓰인다.

G0094.d: ἄδικος, -ον (δίκη), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;] 1. unjust: Rom.3:5, Heb.6:10. 2. unrighteous, wicked: Luk.16:11 18:11, Act.24:15, 1Co.6:1,9 1Pe.3:18; opposite to δίκαιος, Mat.5:45; to εὐσεβής, 2Pe.2:9; to πιστός, Luk.16:10 (Cremer, 200). † (AS)
G0094.ks: 공정하지 못한, 악한 것을 뜻하며 '의로운'의 반대이다. 눅 16:10, 행 24:15, 고전 6:1, 9에 쓰인다.

G0095.d: ἀδίκως, adv. (ἄδικος), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;] unjustly, undeservedly: 1Pe.2:19.† (AS)
G0095.ks: 부당하게, 억울하게라는 뜻의 부사이다. 베드로전서 2:19에서 억울하게 고난받음을 말한다.

G0096.d: ἀ-δόκιμος, -ον, [in LXX: Pro.25:4, Isa.1:22 (סִיג) * ;] 1. of things (prop. of metals: LXX, ll. with), not standing the test, rejected: γῆ, Heb.6:8. 2. Of persons, rejected after testing, reprobate: Rom.1:28, 1Co.9:27, 2Co.13:5-7, 2Ti.3:8, Tit.1:16 (Cremer, 212). † (AS)
G0096.ks: 시험을 견디지 못하고 버림받은 것을 뜻한다. 땅이나 사람에게 쓰이며 롬 1:28, 고전 9:27, 고후 13:5에 나온다.

G0097.d: ἄδολος, -ον, 1. guileless (Pind., Thuc). 2. Of liquids (Æsch., Eur., and late prose writers), genuine, pure (in π. and in MGr. of wine, also of corn: MM, VGT, see word; Milligan, NTD, 77): of milk, metaphorically, 1Pe.2:2. † SYN.: ἀκέραιος (which see), ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς. (AS)
G0097.ks: 속임수가 없는, 순수한 것을 뜻한다. 베드로전서 2:2에서 '순전한 젖'을 말할 때 쓰인다.

G0098.d: Ἁδραμυντηνός (T, Rec. Ἀδραμυττηνός), -ή,-όν, of Adramyttium, a seaport of Mysia: Act.27:2.† (AS)

G0099.d: Ἁδρίας (T, Rec. Ἀδρίας), -ου, ὁ, the Adriatic sea, in later Greek usage extended to take in all the waters between Greece and Italy: Act.27:27.† (AS)

G0100.ks: 두께, 활력에서 나아가 풍성한 은혜와 후한 베풂을 뜻한다. 고린도후서 8:20에 쓰였다.

G0101.d: ἀδυνατέω, -ῶ (ἀδύνατος), [in LXX: Deu.17:8, Zec.8:6 (פּלא ni.), Job.42:2 (בּצר ni.), al. ;] 1. Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word). 2. In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: Mat.17:20, Luk.1:37. † (AS)
G0101.ks: 할 수 없다, 불가능하다는 뜻이다. 마태복음 17:20, 누가복음 1:37에 쓰인다.

G0102.d: ἀ-δύνατος, -ον, [in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, דַּל, etc. ;] 1. of persons, unable, powerless: Act.14:8; figuratively Rom.15:1 (MM, VGT, see word). 2. Of things, impossible: Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:27, Luk.18:27, Rom.8:3, Heb.6:4,18 10:4 11:6. † (AS)
G0102.ks: 사람이 무력하여 할 수 없음, 또는 일이 불가능함을 뜻한다. 마 19:26, 롬 8:3, 히 6:4, 18에 쓰인다.

G0103.d: ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω), [in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;] to sing, (a) intrans., with dative (MM, VGT, see word), of praise to God: Eph.5:19, Col.3:16 ; (b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3. † (AS)
G0103.ks: 노래하다라는 뜻이다. 하나님께 찬양을 드릴 때(엡 5:19, 골 3:16)나 새 노래를 부를 때(계 5:9) 쓰인다.

G0104.d: ἀεί, adv., [in LXX: Isa.42:14 (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), Ps 94(95):10, al. ;] ever; 1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Act.7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tit.1:12, Heb.3:10. 2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.3:15, 2Pe.1:12. † (AS)
G0104.ks: 끊임없이, 또는 매번이라는 뜻의 부사이다. 행 7:51, 고후 6:10, 벧전 3:15에 쓰인다.

G0105.d: ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX for נֶשֶׁר ;] an eagle: Rev.4:7 8:13 (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. Job.39:30, Pro.30:17): Mat.24:28, Luk.17:37 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0105.ks: 독수리를 뜻한다. 계 4:7, 8:13, 12:14에 나오며 시체가 있는 곳의 새는 솔개일 수 있다.

G0106.d: ἄζυμος, -ον (ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה ;] unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Mrk.14:1), Luk.22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Mat.26:17, Mrk.14:12, Luk.22:7; ἡμέραι, Act.12:3 20:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: 1Co.5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).† (AS)
G0106.ks: 누룩을 넣지 않은 것을 뜻한다. 무교절과 무교병에 쓰이며 그리스도인의 순결을 비유하기도 한다(고전 5:7).

G0109.d: ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ, [in LXX: 2Ki.22:12 (= Psa.17(18):11 שׁחק), Wi .8 ;] in Hom., Hes., the lower air which surrounds the earth, as opposite to the purer αἰθήρ of the higher regions; generally, air (MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:23, 1Th.4:17, Rev.9:2 16:17; of the air as the realm of demons, Eph.2:2; ἀ. δέρειν, of striving to no purpose, 1Co.9:26; εἰς ἀ. λαλεῖν, of speaking without effect, not being understood, 1Co.14:9.† (AS)
G0109.ks: 땅을 둘러싼 공기, 곧 공중을 뜻한다. 행 22:23, 살전 4:17, 엡 2:2, 고전 9:26에 쓰인다.

G0110.d: ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Wis.3:4 4:1 8:13,17 15:3, 4Ma.14:5 16:13 * ;] immortality: 1Co.15:53,54 1Ti.6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).† (AS)
G0110.ks: 죽지 않음을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 15:53, 54, 디모데전서 6:16에 쓰인다.

G0111.d: ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, see word), -ον (θέμις, custom, right), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:5 7:1 10:34, 3Ma.5:20 * ;] (a) of persons, lawless (III Mac, l.with); (b) of things, lawless, unlawful: Act.10:28, 1Pe.4:3.† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος. (AS)
G0111.ks: 법에 어긋난, 허용되지 않는 것을 뜻한다. 사도행전 10:28, 베드로전서 4:3에 쓰인다.

G0112.d: ἄ-θεος, -ον, 1. in cl. (a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word); (b) godless, ungodly (Pind.); (with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.) 2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph.2:12. † (AS)
G0112.ks: 하나님을 알지 못하는 이방인의 상태를 뜻한다. 에베소서 2:12에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0113.d: ἄθεσμος, -ον (θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:12 6:26 * ;] lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 2Pe.2:7 3:17.† SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b). (AS)
G0113.ks: 자연과 양심의 법을 어기는 무법한 사람을 뜻한다. 베드로후서 2:7, 3:17에 쓰인다.

G0114.d: ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as 1Ki.13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)]. 1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , Gal.3:16; ἐντολήν , Mrk.7:9; νόμον . Heb.10:28; πίστιν , 1Ti.5:12. 2. to nullify, make void: Luk.7:30 (see Field, Notes, 59), 1Co.1:19, Gal.2:21. 3. to reject: Mrk.6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jhn.12:48, I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0114.ks: 정한 것을 무효로 하다, 저버리다, 거절하다라는 뜻이다. 언약, 계명, 율법, 믿음을 저버림에 쓰인다.

G0115.d: ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: 1Ki.24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Jer.12:1 (בֶּגֶד), Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 * ;] a disannulling, setting aside: Heb.7:18 9:26 (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0115.ks: 폐지함, 옆으로 치워 버림을 뜻한다. 히브리서 7:18, 9:26에 쓰인다.

G0116.d: Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts), Athens: Act.17:15,16 18:1, 1Th.3:1.† (AS)

G0117.d: Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)

G0118.d: ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport), to contend in games, wrestle, combat: 2Ti.2:5.† (AS)
G0118.ks: 경기에서 겨루다, 씨름하다라는 뜻이다. 디모데후서 2:5에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0119.d: ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθλέω), a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: Heb.10:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0119.ks: 경기, 특히 운동선수의 겨룸을 뜻하며 비유로 고난의 싸움을 가리킨다. 히브리서 10:32에 쓰였다.

G0120.d: ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart), [in LXX for חרה, etc. ;] to be disheartened: Col.3:21.† (AS)
G0120.ks: 용기를 잃고 실망하다라는 뜻이다. 골로새서 3:21에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0121.d: ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον (θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי ;] 1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word). 2. innocent: Mat.27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24. (AS)
G0121.ks: 벌을 받지 않은, 죄 없는 것을 뜻한다. 마태복음 27:4, 24에 쓰인다.

G0122.d: αἴγειος (WH, -γιος), -α, -ον (αἶξ, a goat), [in LXX for עֵז ;] of a goat: Heb.11:37 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0122.ks: 염소에 속한 것을 뜻한다. 히브리서 11:37에서 염소 가죽을 입은 이들에 쓰였다.

G0123.d: αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word), [in LXX: Jdg.5:17 (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;] the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Mat.13:2,48 Jhn.21:4, Act.21:5 27:39,40.† (AS)

G0124.ks: 애굽(이집트) 사람이나 애굽에 속한 것을 뜻한다. 행 7:22, 24, 28, 21:38, 히 11:29에 쓰인다.

G0125.d: Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ, Egypt: Mat.2:13-15,19, Act.2:10 7:9-39, Heb.3:16 11:26,27; γῆ Αἴ., Act.7:40 13:17, Heb.8:9, Ju 5 (cf. Exo.5:12, al.); ἡ Αἴ., Act.7:11; figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, Rev.11:8.† (AS)

G0126.d: ἀΐδιος, -ον (ἀεί), [in LXX: Wis.7:26, 4Ma.10:15 * ;] everlasting (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word): Rom.1:20, Ju 6.† SYN.: αἰώνιος, also frequently in Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 363 J. The etymological distinction between the meanings of the two words seems not to be retained in late Greek (see Thayer, see word, αἰώνιος; cf. Cremer, 79, 611). (AS)
G0126.ks: 영구한, 끝없는 것을 뜻한다. 로마서 1:20, 유다서 6에 쓰인다.

G0127.d: αἰδώς (-όος), -οῦς, ἡ, [in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 4:5 * ;] a sense of shame, modesty: 1Ti.2:9 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: αἰσχύνη (see Thayer, 14; Tr., Syn., §xix; Cremer, 611 f.; CGT on I Ti, l.with). (AS)
G0127.ks: 부끄러움을 아는 마음과 정숙함을 뜻한다. 디모데전서 2:9에 쓰였다.

G0128.d: .*Αἰθίοψ, -οπος, ὁ (αἴθω, to burn, ὤψ, face; i.e. swarthy), [in LXX for כּוּשׁ ;] Ethiopian: Act.8:27.† (AS)
G0128.ks: 에티오피아 사람, 곧 여왕 간다게의 내시 (행 8:27)

G0129G.d: αἷμα, ατος, τό, [in LXX for דָּם ;] blood. 1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. 2. In special senses: (a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); (b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17, 1Co.15:50, Gal.1:16, Eph.6:12, Heb.2:14; (with) of things in colour resembling blood: Act.2:19,20, Rev.6:12 14:18-20. (d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Mat.23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25, Luk.11:50,51 13:1, Act.1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20, Heb.12:4, Rev.6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2 ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), Rom.3:15, Rev.16:6; (e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: Heb.9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11; of the blood of Christ, Mat.26:28, Mrk.14:24, Luk.22:20, Jhn.6:53,54,56, Act.20:28, Rom.3:25 5:9, 1Co.10:16 11:25,27, Eph.1:7 2:13, Col.1:20, Heb.9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20, 1Pe.1:2,19, 1Jn.1:7 (cf. 5:6,8), Rev.1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.) † (AS)
G0129G.ks: 피를 뜻하며, 혈통·친족 관계나 '혈과 육'(사람의 본성)을 가리키기도 한다. 그리스도의 피 등에 쓰인다.

G0129H.d: αἷμα, ατος, τό, [in LXX for דָּם ;] blood. 1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. 2. In special senses: (a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); (b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17, 1Co.15:50, Gal.1:16, Eph.6:12, Heb.2:14; (with) of things in colour resembling blood: Act.2:19,20, Rev.6:12 14:18-20. (d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Mat.23:30,35 27:4,6,8,24,25, Luk.11:50,51 13:1, Act.1:19 5:28 18:6 20:26 22:20, Heb.12:4, Rev.6:10 17:6 18:24 19:2 ; αἷ. ἐκχέειν (Deiss., LAE, 428; MM, VGT, see word, αἷ.), Rom.3:15, Rev.16:6; (e) of sacrificial blood, as an expiation: Heb.9:7,12,13,18-22,25 10:4 11:28 13:11; of the blood of Christ, Mat.26:28, Mrk.14:24, Luk.22:20, Jhn.6:53,54,56, Act.20:28, Rom.3:25 5:9, 1Co.10:16 11:25,27, Eph.1:7 2:13, Col.1:20, Heb.9:12,14 10:19,29 12:24 13:20, 1Pe.1:2,19, 1Jn.1:7 (cf. 5:6,8), Rev.1:5 5:9 7:14 12:11. (Cremer, 69 f., 612 f.) † (AS)
G0129H.ks: '피'를 뜻하는 낱말로, 가룟 유다가 배신 값으로 산 '피밭'에서 '피'를 가리키는 쓰임이다.

G0130.d: αἱματεκχυσία, -ας, ἡ (αἷμα, ἐκ, χέω), shedding of blood (Eccl.; Cremer, 71): Heb.9:22.† (AS)
G0130.ks: 피를 흘림을 뜻한다. 히브리서 9:22에서 피 흘림이 없이는 사함이 없다고 말할 때 쓰였다.

G0131.d: αἱμορροέω, (αἷμα, ῥέω), [in LXX: Lev.15:33 (דָּוֶה) * ;] to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): Mat.9:20.† (AS)
G0131.ks: 피를 흘리는 병을 앓다라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 9:20에서 열두 해를 혈루증으로 앓던 여인에게 쓰였다.

G0133.d: αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ (αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה ;] praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (Lev.7:12, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), Heb.13:15.† (AS)
G0133.ks: 찬양을 뜻한다. 히브리서 13:15의 '찬송의 제사'(레 7:12의 감사제)에 쓰였다.

G0134.d: αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω, [in LXX chiefly for הלל, ידה ;] to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, Luk.2:13,20 19:37 24:53, Act.2:47 3:8,9, Rom.15:11; with dative, τ. Θεῷ (Jer.20:13, al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), Rev.19:5.† SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211). (AS)

G0135.d: αἴνιγμα, -ατος, τό (αἰνίσσομαι, to speak in riddles; αἰνός = δεινός, dread, strange), [in LXX for חִידָה, Num.12:8 and always exc. Deu.28:37 (שַׁמָּה) ;] a dark saying, riddle: 1Co.13:12 (cf. Nu, l.with).† (AS)
G0135.ks: 어렵고 뜻이 감추어진 말, 수수께끼를 뜻한다. 고린도전서 13:12의 '희미하게'에 쓰였다.

G0136.d: αἶνος, ου, ὁ, [in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז ;] poët, and Ion., 1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.). 2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): Mat.21:16 (LXX), Luk.18:43. 3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0136.ks: 찬송, 칭찬을 뜻한다. 마태복음 21:16, 누가복음 18:43에 쓰인다.

G0138.d: αἱρέω, [in LXX for אמר hi., בּחר, etc. ;] to take; Mid., -ομαι (M, Pr., 158 f.; MM, VGT, see word), to choose: Php.1:22, 2Th.2:13, Heb.11:25. (Cf. ἀν-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐξ-, καθ-, περι-, προ-αιρέω.) † (AS)
G0138.ks: 잡다, 중간태로는 선택하다라는 뜻이다. 빌 1:22, 살후 2:13, 히 11:25에 쓰인다.

G0139.d: αἵρεσις, -εως, ἡ (αἱρέω, -ομαι), [in LXX for נְדָבָה,] 1. capture. 2. choosing, choice (see MM, VGT, see word). 3. that which is chosen, hence, opinion; esp. a peculiar opinion, heresy: 1Co.11:19, Gal.5:20, 2Pe.2:1 R, txt. 4. In late writers (MM, VGT), of a set of persons professing particular principles or opinions, a school, sect, party, faction: Act.5:17 15:5 24:5,14 26:5 28:22, I Co, Ga, II Pe, l.with, R, mg. (Cremer, 614). † (AS)
G0139.ks: 선택, 의견, 그리고 특정한 주장을 따르는 무리(파, 당파)를 뜻한다. 고전 11:19, 갈 5:20, 행 5:17, 15:5에 쓰인다.

G0140.d: αἱρετίζω, [in LXX chiefly for בּחר (see Cremer, 615) ;] = αἱρέομαι (Hipp., Inscr.), to choose: Mat.12:18 (LXX, ἀντιλήμψομαι).† (AS)
G0140.ks: 선택하다라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 12:18의 '내가 택한 자'에 쓰였다.

G0141.d: αἱρετικός, -ή, όν (αἱρέομαι), 1. capable of choosing (Plat.). 2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., Tit.3:10. † (AS)
G0141.ks: 분열을 일으키는 사람을 가리킨다. 디도서 3:10에서 이단에 속한 사람을 말한다.

G0142.d: αἴρω, [in LXX chiefly for נשׂא, also for לקח, etc. ;] 1. to raise, take up, lift or draw up: Jhn.8:59 11:41, Act.27:17, al. 2. to bear, carry: Mat.4:6 16:24, al. 3. to bear or take away, carry off, remove: Mat.21:21, Jhn.19:31, 1Co.5:12 6:15 (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, Jhn.1:29, 1Jn.3:5. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0142.ks: 들어 올리다, 지다, 없애 가져가다라는 뜻이다. 예수께서 세상 죄를 지고 가신다는 말씀(요 1:29)에도 쓰인다.

G0143.d: αἰσθάνομαι, [in LXX for בּין, חפז, ידע ;] to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:45 (Cremer, 619 f.).† (AS)
G0143.ks: 감각으로 알아차리다라는 뜻이다. 누가복음 9:45에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0144.d: αἴσθησις, -εως, ἡ (αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;] perception (MM, VGT, see word): Php.1:9.† SYN.: ἐπίγνωσις, which see (cf. Cremer, 620). (AS)
G0144.ks: 지각, 깨달음을 뜻한다. 빌립보서 1:9에서 사랑이 '모든 총명'으로 더해지기를 구하는 말에 쓰였다.

G0145.d: αἰσθητήριον, -ου, τό (αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX: Jer.4:19 (קִיר), 4Ma.2:22 * ;] sense, organ of perception: Heb.5:14 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0145.ks: 지각하는 기능이나 기관을 뜻한다. 히브리서 5:14에서 훈련된 지각으로 선악을 분변한다는 말에 쓰였다.

G0146.d: αἰσχροκερδής, -ες (αἰσχρός, κέρδος), greedy of base gains: 1Ti.3:3,8 Abbot-Smith omits 1Ti.3:3, Tit.1:7.† (AS)
G0146.ks: 부정한 이익을 탐하는 것을 뜻한다. 딤전 3:3, 8, 딛 1:7에서 직분자가 갖추지 말아야 할 성품으로 쓰인다.

G0147.ks: 부정한 이익을 탐하는 마음으로라는 뜻의 부사이다. 베드로전서 5:2에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0148.d: αἰσχρολογία, -ας, ἡ (αἰσχρός, λέγω), abusive language, abuse (Lft., ICC, in l.; MM, VGT, see word): Col.3:8.† (AS)
G0148.kg: 악한 말, 입에 담기 부끄러운 말
G0148.ks: 욕설이나 상스러운 말을 뜻한다. 골로새서 3:8에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0150.d: αἰσχρός, -ά, όν (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: Gen.41:3 ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;] base, shameful: 1Co.11:6 14:35, Eph.5:12, Tit.1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0150.ks: 천하고 부끄러운 것을 뜻한다. 고전 11:6, 14:35, 엡 5:12, 딛 1:11에 쓰인다.

G0151.ks: 천하고 부끄러운 것을 뜻한다. 에베소서 5:4에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0152.d: αἰσχύνη, -ης, ἡ (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX chiefly for בּשֶׁת ;] shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, Luk.14:19, 2Co.4:2; objectively, Php.3:19, Heb.12:2; as something to be ashamed of, Rev.3:18; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.† SYN.: αἰδώς, which see (AS)
G0152.ks: 부끄러운 마음이나 부끄러운 일을 뜻한다. 눅 14:9, 빌 3:19, 히 12:2, 계 3:18에 쓰인다.

G0153.d: αἰσχύνω (αἶσχος, shame), [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;] 1. to disfigure (Hom.). 2. to dishonour (Pro.29:15). 3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: 2Co.10:8; Php.1:20, 1Pe.4:16, 1Jn.2:28; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luk.16:3 (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω). † (AS)
G0153.ks: 수치를 당하다, 부끄러워하다라는 뜻이다. 고후 10:8, 빌 1:20, 벧전 4:16, 요일 2:28에 쓰인다.

G0154.d: αἰτέω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for שׁאל ;] to ask, request: absol., Mat.7:7, Jas.1:6; with accusative of person(s), Mat.5:42, Luk.6:30; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.20:20, 1Jn.5:15; id. before παρά, Act.3:2, Jas.1:5; with dupl. accusative Mat.7:9, Mrk.6:22, Jhn.16:23. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., Mrk.15:8, Jhn.16:26, Jas.4:3; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.14:7, Mrk.6:24, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:20, Luk.23:25; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, Act.9:2; with accusative and inf., Luk.23:23. with inf. Act.7:46, Eph.3:13 (cf. ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, προσ- αιτέω). SYN.: ἐρωτάω, which see, πυνθάνομαι. On the proper distinction between these words, see Tr., Syn., § xl, Thayer, see word αἰ. In late Gk., however, αἰ. and ἐ. seem to have become practically synonymous (cf. Act.3:2,3; see Field, Notes, 101 f.; M, Th., I, 4:1; M, Pr., 66.n; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0154.ks: 청하다, 구하다라는 뜻이다. 마 7:7, 약 1:6, 요일 5:15 등에 쓰이며 기도로 구하는 데 자주 쓰인다.

G0155.d: αἴτημα, -ατος, τό (αἰτέω), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁאֵלָה ;] that which has been asked for, a petition, request: Luk.23:24, Php.4:6, Jhn.5:15.† SYN.: see: δέησις. (AS)
G0155.ks: 간구하여 얻고자 하는 것을 뜻한다. 눅 23:24, 빌 4:6, 요일 5:15에 쓰인다.

G0156.d: αἰτία, -ας, ἡ, [in LXX: Gen.4:13 (עָוֹן), Pro.28:17 (עָשַׁק), and frequently in Wi, II, III Mac ;] 1. cause, reason, occasion, case: Mat.19:3, Luk.8:47, Act.10:21 22:24 28:20, 2Ti.1:6,12, Tit.1:13, Heb.2:11 ; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), Mat.19:10. 2. In forensic sense, (a) accusation: Act.25:18,27; (b) cause for punishment, crime: Mat.27:37, Mrk.15:26, Jhn.18:38 19:4,6, Act.13:28 23:28 28:18. † SYN.: ἔλεγχος, a charge, whether moral or judicial, which has been proven, αἰ. is an accusation simply, false or true. (AS)
G0156.ks: 까닭, 이유를 뜻하며 법적으로는 고소, 죄목을 가리킨다. 마 19:3, 행 25:18, 27에 쓰인다.

G0157.d: αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό (αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία), a charge, accusation: Act.25:7.† (AS)
G0157.ks: 고소, 죄목을 뜻한다. 사도행전 25:7에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0159.d: αἴτιος, -α, ὁ (αἰτία), [in LXX: 1Ki.22:22 (סבב) Dan LXX Bel 41, TH ib. 42, Su 53, 2Ma.4:47 13:4, 4Ma.1:11 * ;] 1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: Heb.5:9; τὸ αἰ., the cause, Act.19:40. 2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, Luk.23:4,14,22. † (AS)
G0159.ks: 원인이 되는 것, 또는 죄가 있는 사람을 뜻한다. 히브리서 5:9에서 그리스도를 구원의 근원이라 한다.

G0160.d: αἰφνίδιος (in Lk, l.with, ἐφν- WH; see M, Pr., 35), -ον (αἴφνης = ἄφνως, suddenly), [in LXX: Wis.17:15, 2Ma.14:17, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] sudden, unexpected: Luk.21:34, 1Th.5:3.† (AS)
G0160.ks: 뜻밖의, 갑자기 닥치는 것을 뜻한다. 누가복음 21:34, 데살로니가전서 5:3에 쓰인다.

G0161.d: αἰχμαλωσία -ας, ἡ (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִי, גּוֹלָה ;] captivity (Diod., al.): Rev.13:10; pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, Eph.4:8 (LXX).† (AS)
G0161.ks: 사로잡힌 상태를 뜻한다. 요한계시록 13:10, 에베소서 4:8에 쓰인다.

G0162.d: αἰχμαλωτεύω (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] = αἰχμαλωτίζω, which see, to lead captive: Eph.4:8 (LXX).† (AS)
G0162.ks: 사로잡아 끌고 가다라는 뜻이다. 에베소서 4:8에서 '사로잡은 자들을 사로잡으시고'에 쓰였다.

G0163.d: αἰχμαλωτίζω (αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω), to take or lead captive: before εἰς, Luk.21:24 (cf. Tob.1:10); metaphorically, Rom.7:23, 2Co.10:5, 2Ti.3:6.† (AS)
G0163.ks: 사로잡거나 포로로 끌고 가다라는 뜻이다. 눅 21:24와 비유로 롬 7:23, 고후 10:5에 쓰인다.

G0164.d: αἰχμάλωτος, -ον (αἰχμή, a spear, ἁλίσκομαι, to be taken), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבָה, גּוֹלָה ;] captive: Luk.4:18 (LXX).† (AS)
G0164.ks: 사로잡힌 사람을 뜻한다. 누가복음 4:18의 '포로된 자에게 자유를'에 쓰였다.

G0165G.d: αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); (a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70; (b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never, Jhn.4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Heb.1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Mat.6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Isa.45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Rom.16:27, LT; cf. also Eph.3:21, 2Pe.3:18, Ju 25, Rev.14:11. 2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. 1Ti.1:17, where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity". 3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., Mat.13:22; ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, Mat.12:32; ὁ νῦν αἰ., 1Ti.6:17; ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., Gal.1:4; similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, Luk.20:35; ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, Mat.12:32; ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, Mrk.10:30. SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on Heb.1:2; Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT). (AS)
G0165G.ks: 오랜 기간, 시대를 뜻한다. 과거와 미래의 기한 없는 때, 또는 이 세상 시대를 가리킨다.

G0165H.d: αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;] 1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); (a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70; (b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never, Jhn.4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Heb.1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Mat.6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Isa.45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Rom.16:27, LT; cf. also Eph.3:21, 2Pe.3:18, Ju 25, Rev.14:11. 2. οἱ αἰ., the worlds, the universe, "the sum of the periods of time, including all that is manifested in them": He :12 11:3 (cf. 1Ti.1:17, where τῶν αἰ. are prob. "the ages or world-periods which when summed up make eternity". 3. the present age (Heb. הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה): ὁ αἰ., Mat.13:22; ὁ αἰ. οὗτος, Mat.12:32; ὁ νῦν αἰ., 1Ti.6:17; ὁ ἐνεστὼς αἰ., Gal.1:4; similarly, of the time after Christ's second coming (הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא), ὁ αἰ. ἐκεῖνος, Luk.20:35; ὁ αἰ. μέλλων, Mat.12:32; ὁ αἰ. ὁ ἐρχόμενος, Mrk.10:30. SYN.: κόσμος, the ordered universe, the scheme of material things; οἰκουμένη, the inhabited earth; in contrast with both of which αἰ. is the world under aspects of time (cf. Westc. on Heb.1:2; Tr., Syn., §lix; Thayer, see word, αἰ.; Cremer, 74, 620; MM, VGT). (AS)
G0165H.ks: 끝없는 오랜 시간, 영원을 뜻한다. '영원히'(εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα) 같은 표현에 쓰인다.

G0166.d: αἰώνιος, -ον (as usual in Attic), also -α, -ον. 2Th.2:16, Heb.9:12; (αἰών), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹלָם ;] age-long, eternal, (a) of that which is without either beginning or end: Rom.16:26, Heb.9:14; (b) of that which is without beginning: Rom.16:25, 2Ti.1:9, Tit.1:2; (with) of that which is without end (MM, VGT, see word): σκηναί, Luk.16:9 οἰκία, 2Co.5:1; διαθήκη, Heb.13:20; εὐαγγέλιον, Rev.14:6; παράκλησις, 2Th.2:16; λύτρωσις, Heb.9:12; κληρονομία, ib. 15; κόλασις, Mat.25:46; κρίμα, Heb.6:2; κρίσις, Mrk.3:29; ὄλεθρον, 2Th.1:9; πῦρ, Mat.18:8; frequently with ζωή, which see SYN.: ἀΐδιος, which see (AS)
G0166.ks: 세대에 걸친, 영원한 것을 뜻한다. 시작이나 끝이 없는 하나님과 관련해 쓰이고 영생 등에도 쓰인다.

G0167.d: ἀκαθαρσία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκάθαρτος), [in LXX chiefly for טֻמְאָה, טָמֵא ;] uncleanness, impurity, (a) physical (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.23:27; (b) moral: Rom.1:24 6:19, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19, Eph.4:19 5:3, Col.3:5, 1Th.2:3 4:7. † (AS)
G0167.ks: 육체적인 더러움과 도덕적인 부정을 뜻한다. 마 23:27, 롬 1:24, 갈 5:19, 엡 4:19 등에 쓰인다.

G0169.d: ἀκάθαρτος, -ον (ἀ- neg., καθαίρω), [in LXX chiefly for טָמֵא ;] unclean, impure; (a) physically (LS, MM, VGT, see word); (b) ceremonially: Act.10:14,28 11:8, 1Co.7:14, 2Co.6:17, Rev.18:2; (with) morally: Eph.5:5, Rev.17:4; with πνεῦμα, as always in Gosp., Mat.10:1 12:43, Mrk.1:23,26,27 3:11,30 5:2,8,13 6:7 7:25 9:25, Luk.4:33,36 6:18 8:29 9:42 11:24, Act.5:16 8:7, Rev.16:13 (cf. Cremer, 320). † (AS)
G0169.ks: 육체적, 의식적, 도덕적으로 깨끗하지 못한 것을 뜻한다. 복음서에서 '더러운 귀신(영)'에 자주 쓰인다.

G0170.d: ἀκαιρέομαι, -οῦμαι (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), to have no opportunity (opposite to εὐκαιρέω): Php.4:10.† (AS)
G0170.ks: 기회를 얻지 못하다라는 뜻이다. 빌립보서 4:10에서 빌립보 교인들이 마음은 있으나 기회가 없었음을 말한다.

G0171.d: ἀκαίρως, adv. (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;] out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0171.ks: 철에 맞지 않게, 적절치 않은 때에라는 뜻의 부사이다. 디모데후서 4:2에서 '때를 얻든지 못 얻든지'에 쓰였다.

G0172.d: ἄκακος, -ον, [in LXX for פְּתִי, תָּם, etc. ;] (a) as in cl. (Æsch., Plat., al.), of persons, simple, guileless: Rom.16:18, Heb.7:26 (cf. Cremer, 327); (b) of things, undamaged (? MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0172.ks: 악의 없는 순진한 사람을 뜻한다. 롬 16:18, 히 7:26에서 죄 없으신 대제사장에게도 쓰인다.

G0173.d: ἄκανθα, -ης, ἡ (ἀκή, a point), [in LXX chiefly for קוֹץ, also for סִיר, שַׁיִת, etc. ;] a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: Mat.7:16 13:7,22 27:29, Mrk.4:7,18, Luk.6:44 8:7,14, Jhn.19:2, Heb.6:8 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0173.ks: 가시 있는 식물, 가시나무를 뜻하며 신약에서는 항상 복수로 쓰인다. 마 7:16, 13:7, 27:29 등에 나온다.

G0174.d: ἀκάνθινος, -ον (ἄκανθα), [in LXX: Isa.34:13 (סיר) * ;] 1. of thorns: Mrk.15:17, Jhn.19:5. 2. of acantha-wood (Hdt.; π. ap. MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)
G0174.ks: 가시로 만든 것을 뜻한다. 마가복음 15:17, 요한복음 19:5의 가시 면류관에 쓰였다.

G0175.d: ἄ-καρπος, -ον, [in LXX: Jer.2:6 (צַלְמָוֶת), Wis.15:4, 4Ma.16:7 ;] unfruitful, barren: figuratively, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:19, 1Co.14:14, Eph.5:11, Tit.3:14, 2Pe.1:8, Ju 12.† (AS)
G0175.ks: 열매를 맺지 못하는, 무익한 것을 뜻한다. 마 13:22, 막 4:19, 엡 5:11, 딛 3:14에 쓰인다.

G0176.d: ἀ-κατά-γνωστος, -ον (καταγινώσκω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:47 ;] not open to just rebuke, irreprehensible: Tit.2:8 (see Cremer, 676; and for other exx., MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0176.ks: 비난받을 만한 흠이 없음을 뜻한다. 디도서 2:8에서 바른 말에 대해 쓰였다.

G0177.ks: 덮지 않은, 가리지 않은 것을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 11:5, 13에 쓰인다.

G0178.d: ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον (κατακρίνω), 1. uncondemned (EV): Act.16:37, 22:25. 2. = cl. ἄκριτος, without trial, not yet tried (MM, VGT, see word) Ac, ll. cc. † (AS)
G0178.ks: 정죄되지 않은, 재판받지 않은 것을 뜻한다. 사도행전 16:37, 22:25에서 바울이 로마 시민임을 말할 때 쓰였다.

G0179.ks: 폐하거나 해체할 수 없는 것을 뜻한다. 히브리서 7:16의 '불멸의 생명의 능력'에 쓰였다.

G0180.d: ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον (καταπαύω), that cannot cease, not to be restrained: with genitive of thing(s), 2Pe.2:14, T, Tr. txt.† (AS)
G0180.ks: 멈출 수 없는 것을 뜻한다. 베드로후서 2:14에서 죄를 그치지 않는 눈을 말한다.

G0181.d: ἀκαταστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκατάστατος), [in LXX: Pro.26:28 (מִדְחֶה), Tob.4:13 * ;] instability (MM, VGT, see word); hence, confusion, tumult: 1Co.14:33, Jas.3:16; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), Luk.21:9, 2Co.6:5, 12:20 (Polyb., al.; see Cremer, 739).† (AS)
G0181.ks: 불안정과 무질서, 소요를 뜻한다. 고전 14:33, 약 3:16, 눅 21:9, 고후 6:5에 쓰인다.

G0182.ks: 정하지 못한, 불안정한 것을 뜻한다. 야고보서 1:8, 3:8에 쓰인다.

G0184.d: § Akeldama dama (Proper name) (traditionally located south of the valley of Hinnom), "field of blood"
G0184.ks: '피밭', 가룟 유다가 죽은 뒤 이름 붙은 밭 (행 1:19)

G0185.d: ἀκέραιος, -ον (κεράννυμι), [in LXX: Est.8:13 * ;] unmixed, pure, hence, metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), guileless, simple: Mat.10:16, Rom.16:19, Php.2:15.† SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς (cf. Ellic. on Phl., l.with; Tr., Syn., §lvi). (AS)
G0185.ks: 섞이지 않은 순수한 것에서 나아가 악의 없는 순박함을 뜻한다. 마 10:16, 롬 16:19, 빌 2:15에 쓰인다.

G0186.ks: 굽지 않고 굳센 것을 뜻한다. 히브리서 10:23에서 '움직이지 않고 우리 믿는 도리를 굳게 잡자'에 쓰였다.

G0187.d: ἀκμάζω (ἀκμήν), [in LXX: 4Ma.2:3 * ;] to be at the prime; of produce of the ground, to be ripe (Thuc.): Rev.14:18 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0187.ks: 한창인, 곡식이 무르익다라는 뜻이다. 요한계시록 14:18에서 포도가 익었음을 말한다.

G0188.d: ἀκμήν, accusative of ἀκμή, a point, used as adv., at the present point of time, even now, even yet: Mat.15:16.† (AS)
G0188.ks: 현재의 시점에서 '아직도'라는 뜻의 부사이다. 마태복음 15:16에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0189.d: ἀκοή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀκούω), [in LXX: Exo.15:26, al. for שׁמע, its parts and derivatives, exc. Deu.11:22 (שׁמר) ;] 1. hearing, the sense of hearing: 1Co.12:17, 2Pe.2:8; "Hebraic dative," ἀκοῇ ακούειν (frequently in LXX; V. M, Pr., 14, 75), Mat.13:14, Act.28:26. 2. organ of hearing, the ear (Arist., al.; MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.4:3-4; pl., Mrk.7:35, Luk.7:1, Act.17:20, Heb.5:11. 3. a thing heard, i.e., (a) a message, teaching: Jhn.12:38 and Rom.16:16,17" (LXX), Gal.3:2,5 R, mg.; λόγος ἀκοῆς, 1Th.2:13, Heb.4:2; (b) a report, rumour: with genitive, of person(s), Mat.4:24, 14:1, 24:6; Mrk.1:28 13:7 (Cremer, 82, 623; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0189.ks: 듣는 일, 귀, 들은 소식을 뜻한다. 마 13:14, 딤후 4:3-4, 막 7:35 등에 쓰인다.

G0190.d: ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ (ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), [in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ ;] to accompany, follow: Mat.4:25, al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Mat.9:9, Mrk.9:38, Jhn.12:26, al. Absol.: Mat.18:10; more freq., with dative (cl.), Mat.8:1, al.; before μετά, with genitive, (cl.; Eutherford, N.Phr., 458 f.), Luk.9:49; ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אָהֲרֵי), Mat.10:38 (cf. ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-, συν-ἀκολουθέω). SYN.: (cl.) ἕπομαι, not in NT (see Cremer, 80; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0190.ks: 동행하다, 뒤따르다라는 뜻이다. 비유로 제자로서 예수를 따르는 일을 가리킨다.

G0191.d: ἀκούω, [in LXX chiefly for שׁמע ] to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing. 1. Intrans.: Mrk.4:3 7:37, Jas.2:5, Rev.2:7, al.; τ. ὠσίν, Mat.13:15 (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), Mat.13:14, Act.28:26" (LXX) ; ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, Mat.11:15, Mrk.4:23, Rev.2:7, al. 2. Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from whom heard (LS, see word): Act.1:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.12:19, Jhn.3:8 (Abbott, JG, 76), Act.22:9, al.; with dupl. accusative, Jhn.12:18, 1Co.11:18; with genitive of thing(s), Jhn.7:40 (Abbott, JV, 116); τ. φωνῆς (cf. Heb. שָׁמַע בְּקוֹל, Exo.18:19), Jhn.5:25, 28 Act.9:7 (on the distinction bet. this and ἀ. φωνήν, ib. 4, see M, Pr., 66; Field, Notes, 117; Abbott, Essays, 93f.); of God answering prayer, Jhn.9:31, 1Jn.5:14, 15; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, Jhn.8:26, 40 Act.10:22, 2Ti.2:2; id. before ἀπό, 1Jn.1:5; with genitive pars. before ptcp., Mrk.14:58, Luk.18:36, al. (On NT usage generally, see Bl., §36, 5; Cremer, 82.) (AS)
G0191.ks: 듣다, 귀 기울이다, 들어서 깨닫다라는 뜻이다. '들을 귀 있는 자는 들으라'는 말씀 등에 쓰인다.

G0192.d: ἀκρασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκρατής, which see), [in LXX: 1Ma.6:26 * ;] in Arist. and later writers = ἀκράτεια (Lft., Notes, 222 f.), want of power, hence want of self-control, incontinence: Mat.23:25, 1Co.7:5.† (AS)
G0192.ks: 자제력이 없음을 뜻한다. 마태복음 23:25, 고린도전서 7:5에 쓰인다.

G0193.d: ἀκρατής, -ές (κράτος), [in LXX: Pro.27:20 * ;] (a) powerless, impotent; (b) in moral sense, lacking self-control, incontinent: 2Ti.3:3.† (AS)
G0193.ks: 자제력이 없는 것을 뜻한다. 디모데후서 3:3에서 말세의 사람들의 모습으로 쓰였다.

G0194.ks: 섞지 않은 순수한 것을 뜻한다. 요한계시록 14:10에서 하나님의 진노의 포도주를 말할 때 쓰였다.

G0195.d: ἀκρίβεια, -ας, ἡ (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH 7:16 (יַצִּיב), Wis.12:21, Sir.16:25 42:4 * ;] exactness, precision (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:3.† (AS)
G0195.ks: 정확하고 엄밀함을 뜻한다. 사도행전 22:3에서 바울이 율법을 '엄한 교훈'으로 배웠다고 말할 때 쓰였다.

G0196.d: ἀκριβής, -ές [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:45 6:12 (יַצִּיב) Dan.4:25, Est.4:5, Sir.18:29 19:25 31:24 32:3 * ;] exact, precise, careful, of things and persons: superl., Act.26:5.† (AS)
G0196.ks: 정확하고 엄격한 것의 최상급이다. 사도행전 26:5에서 '가장 엄한 종파'에 쓰였다.

G0197.d: ἀκριβῶς adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deu.19:18 (יָטַב), Da TH 7:19 (יְצֵב), Eze.39:14, Wis.19:18, Sir.18:29 ;] with exactness, carefully: Mat.2:8, Luk.1:3, Act.18:25, Eph.5:15, 1Th.5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.† (AS)
G0197.ks: '정확히'의 비교급으로, 더 자세히라는 뜻이다. 사도행전 18:26, 23:15, 20, 24:22에 쓰인다.

G0198.d: ἀκριβόω, -ῶ (ἀκριβής), [in Aq.: Isa.30:8 49:16 * ;] to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: Mat.2:7, 16 (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).† (AS)
G0198.ks: 정확하게 알아보다, 세밀히 캐묻다라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 2:7, 16에서 헤롯이 박사들에게 때를 알아본 일에 쓰였다.

G0199.d: ἀκριβῶς adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deu.19:18 (יָטַב), Da TH 7:19 (יְצֵב), Eze.39:14, Wis.19:18, Sir.18:29 ;] with exactness, carefully: Mat.2:8, Luk.1:3, Act.18:25, Eph.5:15, 1Th.5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.† (AS)
G0199.ks: 정확하게, 주의 깊게라는 뜻의 부사이다. 마 2:8, 눅 1:3, 행 18:25, 엡 5:15에 쓰인다.

G0200.d: ἀκρίς, -ίδος, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אַרְבֶּה, also for חָגָב, etc. ;] a locust: Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6, Rev.9:3, 7.† (AS)
G0200.ks: 메뚜기를 뜻한다. 마태복음 3:4, 마가복음 1:6, 요한계시록 9:3, 7에 쓰인다.

G0201.d: ἀκροατήριον, -ου, τό (ἀκροάομαι, to listen) a place of audience: Act.25:23 (Plut.).† (AS)
G0201.ks: 듣는 자들이 모이는 장소를 뜻한다. 사도행전 25:23에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0202.d: ἀκροατής, οῦ, ὁ (see supr.) [in LXX: Isa.3:3 (לַחַשׁ), Sir.3:29 ;] a hearer: Rom.2:13, Jas.1:22, 23, 25.† (AS)
G0202.ks: 말씀을 듣는 사람을 뜻한다. 롬 2:13, 약 1:22, 23, 25에서 '행하는 자'와 대비된다.

G0203.d: ἀκροβυστία, -ας, ή (perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, VGT, see word) [in LXX for עׇרְלָה ;] the prepuce, foreskin (LXX), hence abstr., uncircumcision: Act.11:3, Rom.2:25-27 3:30 4:10-12, 1Co.7:18-19, Gal.5:6 6:15, Col.2:13 3:11 By meton., the uncircumcised: Rom.4:9, Gal.2:7, Eph.2:11.† (AS)
G0203.ks: 포피, 곧 할례받지 않은 상태를 뜻하며 비유로 할례받지 않은 사람, 곧 이방인을 가리킨다.

G0204.d: ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος, -αία, -αῖον (ἄκροι, γωνία, an angle) [in LXX: Isa.28:16 (פִּנָּה) * ;] = Attic γωνιαῖος (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word ἀ.), at the extreme angle: ὁ ἀ., the corner foundation stone, Eph.2:20, 1Pe.2:6.† (AS)
G0204.ks: 가장 끝 모서리에 놓인 기초석을 뜻한다. 에베소서 2:20, 베드로전서 2:6에서 그리스도를 가리킨다.

G0205.d: ἀκροθίνιον, -ου, τό (ἄκρος, θίς, a heap), prop., the top of a heap, hence, in pl., 1. first-fruits (Xen.; MM, VGT, see word). 2. In war, the choicest spoils (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): Heb.7:4. † (AS)
G0205.ks: 쌓인 것의 맨 위, 전쟁에서 얻은 가장 좋은 노획물을 뜻한다. 히브리서 7:4에서 아브라함이 바친 것에 쓰였다.

G0206.d: ἄκρος, -α, -ον [in LXX for קֶצַח, בֹּהֶן, etc. ;] highest, extreme; as subst., τὸ ἄ., the top, extremity: Mrk.13:27, Luk.16:24, Heb.11:21; pl. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Mat.24:31.† (AS)
G0206.ks: 가장 높은 곳, 끝을 뜻한다. 마 24:31, 막 13:27, 눅 16:24, 히 11:21에 쓰인다.

G0207.d: Ἀκύλας, -ου (and -α; MM, VGT, see word), ὁ (Lat.), Aquila: Act.18:2, 18 18:26, Rom.16:3, 1Co.16:19, 2Ti.4:19.† (AS)

G0208.d: ἀκυρόω, -ῶ (κῦρος, authority), [in LXX: 1Es.6:32 Est.6:1-34, 2Ma.6:1-31 * ;] to revoke, invalidate (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.15:6, Mrk.7:13, Gal.3:17 (Plut.).† (AS)
G0208.ks: 효력을 없애다, 폐하다라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 15:6, 마가복음 7:13, 갈라디아서 3:17에 쓰인다.

G0209.d: ἀκωλύτως adv. (κωλύω), [in Sm.: Job.34:31 * ;] without hindrance (so frequently in legal documents; MM, VGT, see word): Act.28:31.† (AS)
G0209.ks: 방해받지 않고라는 뜻의 부사이다. 사도행전 28:31에서 바울이 거침없이 전도한 것을 말한다.

G0210.d: ἀκων (Attic contr. for ἀέκων), -ουα, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἅκων, willing), [in LXX: Job.14:17, 2Ma.11:12 * ;] unwilling: 1Co.9:17.† (AS)
G0210.ks: 자원하지 않는 것을 뜻한다. 고린도전서 9:17에서 '자의로 하지 않으면'이라는 말에 쓰였다.

G0211.d: ἀλάβαστρον, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος), [in LXX: 4Ki.21:13 (צַלַּחַת)* ;] a box of alabaster (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: Mat.26:7, Mrk.14:3, Luk.7:37 (see DCG, i, 41b; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0211.ks: 향유를 담는 옥(대리석) 그릇을 뜻한다. 마 26:7, 막 14:3, 눅 7:37에서 향유를 담은 옥합에 쓰였다.

G0212.d: ἀλαζονία(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ (ἀλαζών), [in LXX: Wis.5:8 17:7, 2; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;] the character of an ἀλαζών, boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting: Jas.4:16 (Mayor, in l), 1Jn.2:16.† (AS)
G0212.ks: 허풍을 떨고 뽐내는 성품을 뜻한다. 야고보서 4:16, 요한일서 2:16의 '이생의 자랑'에 쓰인다.

G0213.d: ἀλαζών, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ (ἄλη, wandering) [in LXX: Job.28:8 (שַׁחַץ) Hab.2:5 (יָהִיר), Pro.21:24 (לוּץ)* ;] prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.† SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)
G0213.ks: 떠돌이에서 나아가 허풍 치는 사람, 자랑하는 자를 뜻한다. 로마서 1:30, 디모데후서 3:2에 쓰인다.

G0214.d: ἀλαλάζω (onomat. from the battle-cry ἀλαλά), [in LXX chiefly for רוּעַ hi., יָלַל ;] prop, to raise a war-cry, shout with triumph or joy; rarely of grief, to wail: Mrk.5:38 (cf. Jer.4:8); of a cymbal, ἀλαλάζον (RV. clanging), 1Co.13:1 (cf. ὀλολύζω).† (AS)
G0214.ks: 전쟁의 함성을 올리다, 기쁨의 소리를 내다, 드물게는 슬피 울다라는 뜻이다. 막 5:38, 고전 13:1에 쓰인다.

G0215.ks: 말로 다 할 수 없는 것을 뜻한다. 로마서 8:26에서 성령의 '말할 수 없는 탄식'에 쓰였다.

G0216.ks: 벙어리, 말을 못 하는 것을 뜻한다. 마가복음 7:37, 9:17, 25에 쓰인다.

G0217.d: ἅλας (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for מְלַח ;] salt, lit, and figuratively: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:50 Luk.14:34; like cl. ἅλες, wit, of wisdom and grace in speech: Col.4:6.† (AS)
G0217.ks: 소금을 뜻하며 문자 그대로 또 비유로 쓰인다. 마 5:13, 막 9:50, 눅 14:34, 골 4:6에 나온다.

G0218.d: ἀλείφω (cf. λίπος, oil), [in LXX: Gen.31:13, Exo.40:15, Num.3:3 (מָשַׁח), Eze.13:10 ff. (טוּחַ), Rut.3:3, 2Ki.12:20 14:2, 4Ki.4:2, 2Ch.28:15, Mic.6:15, Dan LXX TH Dan.10:3 (סוּךְ), Est.2:12, Jdth.16:8 * ;] to anoint, festally or in homage: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), Mat.6:17, Jhn.12:3, Mrk.16:1; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, Mrk.6:13, Jas.5:14; μύρῳ, Luk.7:38, 46, Jhn.11:2.† SYN.: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., Syn., § 38, see MM, VGT, see word, ἀ.) (AS)
G0218.ks: 향유나 기름을 바르다라는 뜻이다. 마 6:17, 막 6:13, 약 5:14, 눅 7:38에서 잔치나 존경의 표시로 쓰인다.

G0219.d: ἀλεκτοροφωνία, -ας, ἡ (ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή), cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: Mrk.13:35.† (AS)
G0219.ks: 닭이 우는 때, 곧 밤의 셋째 경점을 뜻한다. 마가복음 13:35에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0220.d: ἀλέκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ (poët. form of ἀλεκτρυών; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Pro.30:31) (זַרְזִיר; BDB, Lex., 267)* ;] a cock: Mat.26:34, Mrk.14:30, 68 14:72 Luk.22:34, 60-61, Jhn.13:38 18:27.† (AS)
G0220.ks: 수탉을 뜻한다. 마 26:34, 막 14:30, 요 13:38 등 베드로의 부인 이야기에 쓰인다.

G0223G.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander 1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. 3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. 4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. 5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0223H.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander 1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. 3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. 4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. 5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0223I.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander 1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. 3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. 4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. 5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0223J.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander 1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. 3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. 4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. 5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0224.d: ἄλευρον, -ου, τό (ἀλεύω, to grind), [in LXX for קֶמַח, Num.5:15, al. ;] real: Mat.13:33, Luk.13:21.† (AS)
G0224.ks: 가루, 밀가루를 뜻한다. 마태복음 13:33, 누가복음 13:21의 누룩 비유에 쓰인다.

G0225.d: ἀλήθεια, -ας, ἡ (ἀληθής), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמֶת (on which, see Cremer, 627f.), אֱמוּנָה ;] truth (see DB, iv, 818f.). 1. Objectively, "the reality lying at the basis of an appearance; the manifested, veritable essence of a matter" (Cremer, 86): Rom.9:1, al.; of religious truth, Rom.1:25, al.; esp. of Christian doctrine, Gal.2:5, al.; ἀ. θεοῦ, Rom.15:8. 2. Subjectively, truthfulness, truth, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character: Jhn.8:44, 3Jo.3. 3. In phrases (MM, VGT, see word): ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας, Mrk.12:14, al.; ἀ. λέγειν (εἰπεῖν, λαλεῖν), Rom.9:1, 2Co.12:6, Eph.4:25, al.; ἀ. ποιεῖν, Jhn.3:21, 1Jn.1:6 (cf. DB, iv, 818b, ff.). (AS)
G0225.ks: 실재, 참됨을 뜻한다. 객관적으로는 종교적 진리, 특히 기독교 교리를, 주관적으로는 진실함을 가리킨다.

G0226.d: ἀληθεύω (ἀληθής), [in LXX: Gen.20:16 (יָכַח) Gen.42:16 (אֶמֶת), Pro.21:3 (מִשְׁפָּט), Isa.44:26 (שָׁלַם), Sir.34:4 * ;] to speak the truth (R, mg., deal truly; Field, Notes, 192): Gal.4:16, Eph.4:15.† (AS)
G0226.ks: 진실을 말하다, 참되게 행하다라는 뜻이다. 갈라디아서 4:16, 에베소서 4:15에 쓰인다.

G0227.d: ἀληθής, -ές (λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real), [in LXX for אֶמֶת, etc. ;] (a) of things, true, conforming to reality: Jhn.4:18 5:31-32 6:55 (= ἀληθινός, which see) Jhn.8:13-14, 17 10:41 19:35 21:24, Act.12:9, Php.4:8, Tit.1:13, 1Pe.5:12, 2Pe.2:22, 1Jn.2:6, 3Jn.12; (b) of persons, truthful: Mat.22:16, Mrk.12:14, Jhn.3:33 7:18 8:26, Rom.3:4, 2Co.6:8.† SYN.: ἀληθινός, real, genuine, ideal, as opposite to spurious or imperfect ἀληθής, true to fact, as opposite to false, lying, denotes the actuality of a thing: ἀληθινός, its relation to the corresponding con­ception. (Cf. Tr., Syn., § viii; Cremer, 84 f., 631 Abbott, JV, 234 f.; DB, iv, 818 f.; MM, VGT, s.vv.) (AS)
G0227.ks: 사실과 일치하는 참됨, 사람이 진실한 것을 뜻한다. 요 4:18, 빌 4:8, 마 22:16 등에 쓰인다.

G0228.d: ἀληθινός, -ή, -όν (ἀληθής), [in LXX for אֶמֶת ;] true, in the sense of real, ideal, genuine: Luk.16:11 Jhn.1:9 4:23, 37 6:32 7:28 8:16 15:1 17:3 19:35, 1Th.1:9, Heb.8:2 9:24 10:22, 1Jn.2:8 Jn 5:20, Rev.3:7, 14 6:10 15:3 16:7 19:2; = ἀληθής, Rev.19:9 21:5 22:6 (MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀληθής, q.v (AS)
G0228.ks: 실재하는, 참된, 진짜인 것을 뜻한다. 요 1:9, 6:32, 15:1, 17:3, 살전 1:9에 쓰인다.

G0229.d: ἀλήθω (κοινή form of the Attic ἀλέω), [in LXX for טָחַן ;] to grind: Mat.24:41, Luk.17:35.† (AS)
G0229.ks: 맷돌로 갈다라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 24:41, 누가복음 17:35에 쓰인다.

G0230.d: ἀληθῶς adv. (ἀληθής). [in LXX (Jer.28:6, Psa.58:1, al.) chiefly for אָמֵן and cogn. forms ;] truly, surely: Mat.14:33 26:73 Mrk.14:70 15:39, Luk.9:27 12:44 21:3, Jhn.1:48 4:42 6:14 7:26, 40 8:31 17:8 Act.12:11, 1Th.2:13, 1Jn.2:5.† (AS)
G0230.ks: 참으로, 확실히라는 뜻의 부사이다. 마 14:33, 26:73, 막 15:39, 요 1:48, 4:42에 쓰인다.

G0231.d: ἁλεεύς (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, App., 151, -έως, ὁ (ἅλς, the sea) [in LXX for דָּג, דַּוָּג ;] a fisherman: Mat.4:18, 19, Mrk.1:16, 17, Luk.5:2 (AS)
G0231.ks: 물고기를 잡는 사람을 뜻한다. 마 4:18, 19, 막 1:16, 17, 눅 5:2에 쓰인다.

G0232.d: ἁλιεύω (ἁλιεύς), [in LXX: Jer.16:16 (דִּיג)* ;] to fish: Jhn.21:3 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0232.ks: 고기잡이하다라는 뜻이다. 요한복음 21:3에서 베드로가 '고기 잡으러 가노라'고 할 때 쓰였다.

G0233.d: ἁλίζω (ἅλς), [in LXX for מָלַח ;] to salt, season with salt: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:49.† (AS)
G0233.ks: 소금을 치다라는 뜻이다. 마태복음 5:13, 마가복음 9:49에 쓰인다.

G0234.ks: 더럽혀진 것을 뜻한다. 사도행전 15:20에서 우상의 더러운 것을 멀리하라는 말에 쓰였다.

G0235.d: ἀλλά (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., Pr., 93 f.; WH, App., 146), adversative particle, stronger than δέ; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. otherwise, on the other hand (cf. Rom.3:31); 1. opposing a previous negation, but: οὐ (μὴ) . . . ἀ., Mat.5:15, 17 Mrk.5:39, Jhn.7:16, al.; rhetorically subordinating but not entirely negativing what precedes, οὐ . . . ἀ., not so much . . . as, Mrk.9:37, Mat.10:20, Jhn.12:44, al.; with ellipse of the negation, Mat.11:7-9, Act.19:2, 1Co.3:6 6:11 7:7, 2Co.7:1, Gal.2:3, al.; in opposition to a foregoing pos. sentence, ἀ. οὐ, Mat.24:6, 1Co.10:23; οὐ μόνον . . . ἀ. καί, Jhn.5:18, Rom.1:32, al.; elliptically, after a negation, ἀ. ἵνα, Mrk.14:49, Jhn.1:8 9:3, al.; = εἰ μή (Bl., §77, 13; M, Pr., 241; but cf. WM, §iii, 10), Mat.20:23, Mrk.4:22. 2. Without previous negation, to express opposition, interruption, transition, etc., but: Jhn.16:20 12:27, Gal.2:14; before commands or requests, Act.10:20 26:16, Mat.9:18, Mrk.9:22, al.; to introduce an accessory idea, 2Co.7:11; in the apodosis after a condition or concession with εἰ, ἐάν, εἴπερ, yet, still, at least, Mrk.14:29, 1Co.9:2, 2Co.4:16, Col.2:5, al.; after μέν, Act.4:17, Rom.14:20, 1Co.14:17; giving emphasis to the following clause, ἀλλ᾽ ἔρχεται ὥρα, yea, etc., Jhn.16:2; so with neg., ἀλλ᾽ οὐδέ, nay, nor yet, Luk.23:15. 3. Joined with other particles (a practice which increases in late writers; Simcox, LNT, 166), ἀ. γε, yet at least, Luk.24:21, 1Co.9:2; ἄ ἤ., save only, except, Luk.12:51, 2Co.1:13; ἀ. μὲν οὖν, Php.3:8 (on this usage, see MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0235.ks: 앞의 부정을 받아 '그러나'라는 뜻으로 대조를 나타내는 접속사이다. '~가 아니라 ~이다'의 꼴로 흔히 쓰인다.

G0236.d: ἀλλάσσω (ἄλλος), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַף, מוּר hi., etc. ;] 1. to change: Act.6:14, Gal.4:20. 2. to transform: 1Co.15:51-52, Heb.1:12. 3. to exchange: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, Psa.106:20) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), Rom.1:23 (cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
G0236.ks: 변하다, 바꾸다, 변화시키다라는 뜻이다. 행 6:14, 갈 4:20, 고전 15:51-52, 롬 1:23에 쓰인다.

G0237.d: ἀλλαχόθεν adv. (ἀλλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:7 * ;] = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, VGT, see word) from another place: Jhn.10:1.† (AS)
G0237.ks: 다른 곳에서라는 뜻의 부사이다. 요한복음 10:1에서 '다른 데로 넘어가는' 도둑을 말할 때 쓰였다.

G0238.ks: 비유로 풀어 말하다, 알레고리로 말하다라는 뜻이다. 갈라디아서 4:24에 한 번 쓰였다.

G0239.d: ἁλληλουιά (Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; Heb. הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), [in LXX in the titles of certain Psa (104 (105), al.), and at the end of Psa.150:1-6; also Tob.13:18, 3Ma.7:13 ;] hallelujah, alleluia: Rev.19:1, 3-4 19:6.† (AS)
G0239.ks: 히브리어 '여호와를 찬양하라'에서 온 감탄사이다. 요한계시록 19:1, 3-4, 6에 쓰인다.

G0240.d: ἀλλήλων (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron. (ἄλλος), of one another, mutually: Mat.25:32, Mrk.4:41, Jhn.13:22, al. (AS)
